   270	@router.get("/statements", response_model=StorageStatementsOut)
   271	async def list_statements(
   272	    user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_storage_access)],
   273	    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
   274	    year: int | None = None,
   275	    month: int | None = None,
   276	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
   277	) -> StorageStatementsOut:
   278	    """Show one calendar month's storage drafts without producing money."""
   279	    if (year is None) != (month is None):
   280	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="year_and_month_required_together")
   281	    try:
   282	        period_start, period_end = (
   283	            month_bounds(year, month)
   284	            if year is not None and month is not None
   285	            else previous_month()
   286	        )
   287	    except StorageMeasurementError as exc:
   288	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
   289	    if period_start > datetime.now(MOSCOW).date().replace(day=1):
   290	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="future_month")
   291	
   292	    warehouse_query = (
   293	        select(Warehouse)
   294	        .where(
   295	            Warehouse.tenant_id == user.tenant_id,
   296	            Warehouse.is_operational.is_(True),
   297	        )
   298	        .order_by(Warehouse.name, Warehouse.id)
   299	    )
   300	    all_operational_warehouses = list(
   301	        (await session.scalars(warehouse_query)).all()
   302	    )
   303	    operational_ids = {
   304	        warehouse.id for warehouse in all_operational_warehouses
   305	    }
   306	    warehouses = [
   307	        warehouse
   308	        for warehouse in all_operational_warehouses
   309	        if warehouse_id is None or warehouse.id == warehouse_id
   310	    ]
   311	
   312	    statement_query = (
   313	        select(StorageStatement)
   314	        .options(
   315	            joinedload(StorageStatement.seller),
   316	            joinedload(StorageStatement.warehouse),
   317	        )
   318	        .where(
   319	            StorageStatement.tenant_id == user.tenant_id,
   320	            StorageStatement.period_start == period_start,
   321	            StorageStatement.period_end == period_end,
   322	            StorageStatement.warehouse_id.in_(operational_ids or {uuid.UUID(int=0)}),
   323	        )
   324	        .order_by(StorageStatement.created_at, StorageStatement.id)
   325	    )
   326	    if user.role == "fulfillment_seller":
   327	        statement_query = statement_query.where(StorageStatement.seller_id == user.seller_id)
   328	    statements = list((await session.scalars(statement_query)).unique().all())
   329	
   330	    measurement_query = (
   331	        select(StorageMeasurement)
   332	        .options(
   333	            joinedload(StorageMeasurement.product),
   334	            joinedload(StorageMeasurement.dimension_event),
   335	        )
   336	        .where(
   337	            StorageMeasurement.tenant_id == user.tenant_id,
   338	            StorageMeasurement.period_start == period_start,
   339	            StorageMeasurement.period_end == period_end,
   340	            StorageMeasurement.warehouse_id.in_(operational_ids or {uuid.UUID(int=0)}),
   341	        )
   342	        .order_by(StorageMeasurement.product_id)
   343	    )
   344	    if user.role == "fulfillment_seller":
   345	        measurement_query = measurement_query.where(StorageMeasurement.seller_id == user.seller_id)
   346	    rows_by_scope: dict[tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID], list[StorageMeasurement]] = {}
   347	    for row in (await session.scalars(measurement_query)).all():
   348	        rows_by_scope.setdefault((row.seller_id, row.warehouse_id), []).append(row)
   349	
   350	    matrix = await get_tariff_matrix(session, tenant_id=user.tenant_id)
   351	    period_start_at = datetime.combine(period_start, datetime.min.time(), MOSCOW)
   352	    period_end_at = datetime.combine(period_end, datetime.max.time(), MOSCOW)
   353	    tariff_configured = bool(
   354	        await session.scalar(
   355	            select(BillingTariffVersionV2.id).where(
   356	                BillingTariffVersionV2.tenant_id == user.tenant_id,
   357	                BillingTariffVersionV2.service_code == "storage",
   358	                BillingTariffVersionV2.unit == "liter_day",
   359	                BillingTariffVersionV2.enabled.is_(True),
   360	                BillingTariffVersionV2.employee_user_id.is_(None),
   361	                BillingTariffVersionV2.product_id.is_(None),
   362	                BillingTariffVersionV2.valid_from_at < period_end_at,
   363	                or_(
   364	                    BillingTariffVersionV2.valid_to_at.is_(None),
   365	                    BillingTariffVersionV2.valid_to_at > period_start_at,
   366	                ),
   367	                (
   368	                    or_(
   369	                        BillingTariffVersionV2.seller_id.is_(None),
   370	                        BillingTariffVersionV2.seller_id == user.seller_id,
   371	                    )
   372	                    if user.role == "fulfillment_seller"
   373	                    else BillingTariffVersionV2.seller_id.is_(None)
   374	                ),
   375	            )
   376	        )
   377	    )
   378	    rounding_scopes_by_seller: dict[
   379	        uuid.UUID,
   380	        list[tuple[StorageStatement, list[StorageMeasurement]]],
   381	    ] = {}
   382	    for statement in statements:
   383	        priceable_rows = [
   384	            row
   385	            for row in rows_by_scope.get(
   386	                (statement.seller_id, statement.warehouse_id), []
   387	            )
   388	            if row.status == "calculated"
   389	        ]
   390	        if priceable_rows:
   391	            rounding_scopes_by_seller.setdefault(statement.seller_id, []).append(
   392	                (statement, priceable_rows)
   393	            )
   394	
   395	    statement_outputs: list[StorageStatementOut] = []
   396	    for statement in statements:
   397	        if warehouse_id is not None and statement.warehouse_id != warehouse_id:
   398	            continue
   399	        rows = rows_by_scope.get((statement.seller_id, statement.warehouse_id), [])
   400	        output = _statement_out(statement, rows)
   401	        if statement.status == "fixed":
   402	            ledger = await get_storage_ledger_rows(session, user.tenant_id, statement.id)
   403	            _apply_ledger_snapshot(output, rows, ledger)
   404	        elif priceable_rows := [row for row in rows if row.status == "calculated"]:
   405	            try:
   406	                pricing = await get_storage_draft_pricing(
   407	                    session,
   408	                    statement,
   409	                    priceable_rows,
   410	                    rounding_scopes=rounding_scopes_by_seller.get(
   411	                        statement.seller_id, []
   412	                    ),
   413	                )
   414	            except StorageStatementError as exc:
   415	                if str(exc) != "tariff_not_found":
   416	                    raise
   417	            else:
   418	                _apply_draft_pricing(output, rows, pricing)
   419	        statement_outputs.append(output)
   420	
   421	    return StorageStatementsOut(
   422	        tariff_configured=tariff_configured,
   423	        tariff_revision=matrix.revision,
   424	        warehouses=[{"id": warehouse.id, "name": warehouse.name} for warehouse in warehouses],
   425	        statements=statement_outputs,
   426	    )

   429	@router.post("/tariffs", response_model=TariffCreateOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
   430	async def create_tariff(
   431	    body: TariffCreateBody,
   432	    user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_fulfillment_admin)],
   433	    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
   434	) -> TariffCreateOut:
   435	    """Create a storage rate for a warehouse; optionally add a seller override atomically.
   436	
   437	    Only ``fulfillment_admin`` can configure tariffs.  If a seller exception is
   438	    supplied, both the common warehouse tariff and the seller override are
   439	    written in a single database transaction — a failure on either INSERT leaves
   440	    no partial state.
   441	    """
   442	    seller_ex = (
   443	        (
   444	            body.seller_exception.seller_id,
   445	            body.seller_exception.amount,
   446	            body.seller_exception.valid_from,
   447	        )
   448	        if body.seller_exception is not None
   449	        else None
   450	    )
   300	            for start, end, held, volume, dimension_event in _volume_segments(
   301	                product_moves,
   302	                effective_events,
   303	                period_start_at,
   304	                period_end_exclusive,
   305	                legacy_volume_liters=product.volume_liters,
   306	            ):
   307	                if held <= 0:
   308	                    continue
   309	                if volume is not None:
   310	                    volume_days += Decimal(held) * _seconds(start, end) * volume
   311	                    applicable_dimension_event = dimension_event
   312	                else:
   313	                    has_missing_dimensions = True
   314	            missing_dimensions = quantity_days > 0 and has_missing_dimensions
   315	            if missing_dimensions:
   316	                problems += 1
   317	            rows.append(
   318	                StorageMeasurement(
   319	                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
   320	                    seller_id=scope_seller_id,
   321	                    warehouse_id=wh_id,
   322	                    product_id=product_id,
   323	                    dimension_event_id=(
   324	                        applicable_dimension_event.id if applicable_dimension_event else None
   325	                    ),
   326	                    period_start=period_start,
   327	                    period_end=period_end,
   328	                    quantity_days=quantity_days,
   329	                    movement_start_id=first_movement.id if first_movement else None,
   330	                    movement_end_id=last_movement.id if last_movement else None,
   331	                    liter_days=volume_days,
   332	                    status="missing_dimensions" if missing_dimensions else "calculated",
   333	                )
   334	            )
   335	    seller_ids = {seller_id} if seller_id is not None else set(
   336	        (await session.scalars(select(Seller.id).where(Seller.tenant_id == tenant_id))).all()
   337	    )
   338	    warehouse_ids = operational_warehouse_ids
   339	    scopes = {(r.seller_id, r.warehouse_id) for r in rows}
   340	    scopes |= {(seller_id, wh_id) for seller_id in seller_ids for wh_id in warehouse_ids}
   341	    for seller_id, wh_id in scopes:
   342	        statement = await session.scalar(
   343	            select(StorageStatement).where(
   344	                StorageStatement.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   345	                StorageStatement.seller_id == seller_id,
   346	                StorageStatement.warehouse_id == wh_id,
   347	                StorageStatement.period_start == period_start,
   348	                StorageStatement.period_end == period_end,
   349	            )
   350	        )
   351	        if statement is not None and statement.status != "draft":
   352	            continue
   353	        await session.execute(
   354	            delete(StorageMeasurement).where(
   355	                StorageMeasurement.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   356	                StorageMeasurement.seller_id == seller_id,
   357	                StorageMeasurement.warehouse_id == wh_id,
   358	                StorageMeasurement.period_start == period_start,
   359	                StorageMeasurement.period_end == period_end,
   360	            )
   361	        )
   362	        if statement is None:
   363	            session.add(
   364	                StorageStatement(
   365	                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
   366	                    seller_id=seller_id,
   367	                    warehouse_id=wh_id,
   368	                    period_start=period_start,
   369	                    period_end=period_end,
   370	                    status="draft",
   371	                )
   372	            )
   373	    open_scopes: set[tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID]] = set()
   374	    for seller_id, wh_id in scopes:
   375	        statement = await session.scalar(
   376	            select(StorageStatement).where(
   377	                StorageStatement.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   378	                StorageStatement.seller_id == seller_id,
   379	                StorageStatement.warehouse_id == wh_id,
   380	                StorageStatement.period_start == period_start,
   381	                StorageStatement.period_end == period_end,
   382	                StorageStatement.status == "draft",
   383	            )
   384	        )
   385	        if statement is not None:
   386	            open_scopes.add((seller_id, wh_id))
   387	    session.add_all([row for row in rows if (row.seller_id, row.warehouse_id) in open_scopes])
   388	    # The background job owns the transaction: it must be able to roll back the
   389	    # replacement together with a later job failure and preserve the last
   390	    # successful draft.
   391	    await session.flush()
   392	    return {
   393	        "period_start": period_start.isoformat(),
   394	        "period_end": period_end.isoformat(),
   395	        "measurements": len(rows),
   396	        "problems": problems,
   397	    }

   227	    async_client: AsyncClient,
   228	    *,
   229	    status: str = "calculated",

   231	    current_month: bool = False,

   233	) -> tuple[dict[str, str], uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID | None]:
   234	    suffix = str(time.time_ns())

   253	    today = datetime.now(MOSCOW).date()
   254	    if current_month:

   293	                )
   294	            )
   295	        if not zero:
   296	            product = Product(
   297	                tenant_id=warehouse.tenant_id,
   298	                seller_id=seller.id,
   299	                name="Stored product",
   300	                sku_code=f"STORAGE-{suffix}",
   301	                volume_liters=1,
   302	                dimensions_source="manual",
   303	            )
   304	            session.add(product)
   305	            await session.flush()
   306	            event = ProductDimensionEvent(
   307	                tenant_id=warehouse.tenant_id,
   308	                product_id=product.id,
   309	                source="manual",

   311	                volume_liters=Decimal("1"),
   312	                applied=True,
   313	                fingerprint=f"manual-{suffix}",
   314	            )
   315	            session.add(event)
   316	            location = await get_or_create_sorting_location(
   317	                session, warehouse.tenant_id, warehouse.id
   318	            )
   319	            movement = InventoryMovement(

   328	            )
   329	            session.add(movement)
   330	            await session.flush()
   331	            measurement = StorageMeasurement(
   332	                tenant_id=warehouse.tenant_id,

   334	                warehouse_id=warehouse.id,

   338	                movement_end_id=movement.id,

   340	                period_end=period_end,
   341	                quantity_days=Decimal(period_end.day),
   342	                liter_days=Decimal(period_end.day),
   343	                status=status,
   344	            )
   345	            session.add(measurement)
   346	            await session.flush()
   347	            measurement_id = measurement.id
   348	        await session.flush()
   349	        statement_id = statement.id
   350	        await session.commit()

   640	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   641	                seller_id=seller_id,
   642	                name=f"Cross-warehouse fractional product {number}",
   643	                sku_code=f"cross-warehouse-fractional-{number}-{suffix}",
   644	                volume_liters=0.0049,
   645	                dimensions_source="manual",
   646	            )
   647	            session.add(product)
   648	            await session.flush()
   649	            dimension = ProductDimensionEvent(
   650	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   651	                product_id=product.id,
   652	                source="manual",
   653	                observed_at=datetime.combine(period_start, datetime_time.min, MOSCOW),
   654	                volume_liters=Decimal("0.0049"),
   655	                applied=True,
   656	                fingerprint=f"cross-warehouse-fractional-event-{number}-{suffix}",
   657	            )
   658	            location = await get_or_create_sorting_location(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   659	            movement_in = InventoryMovement(
   660	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   661	                seller_id=seller_id,
   662	                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   663	                storage_location_id=location.id,
   664	                product_id=product.id,
   665	                quantity_delta=1,
   666	                movement_type="cross_warehouse_fractional_storage_test",
   667	                created_at=datetime.combine(period_start, datetime_time.min, MOSCOW),
   668	            )
   669	            movement_out = InventoryMovement(
   670	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   671	                seller_id=seller_id,
   672	                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   673	                storage_location_id=location.id,
   674	                product_id=product.id,
   675	                quantity_delta=-1,
   676	                movement_type="cross_warehouse_fractional_storage_test",
   677	                created_at=datetime.combine(
   678	                    period_start + timedelta(days=1), datetime_time.min, MOSCOW
   679	                ),
   680	            )
   681	            statement = StorageStatement(
   682	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   683	                seller_id=seller_id,
   684	                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   685	                period_start=period_start,
   686	                period_end=period_end,
   687	                status="draft",
   688	            )
   689	            session.add_all([dimension, movement_in, movement_out, statement])
   690	            await session.flush()
   691	            session.add(

   693	                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
   694	                    seller_id=seller_id,

   713	@pytest.mark.asyncio
   714	async def test_fractional_warehouse_statements_sum_to_seller_report_and_invoice(
   715	    async_client: AsyncClient,
   716	) -> None:
   717	    """A1-CR-003: allocation cannot lose a seller-day kopeck at warehouse boundaries."""
   718	    headers, seller_id, _warehouse_ids, statement_ids = (
   719	        await _create_cross_warehouse_fractional_storage_case(async_client)
   720	    )
   721	    period_start = date(2026, 7, 1)
   722	    period_end = date(2026, 7, 31)
   723	    statement_response = await async_client.get(
   724	        "/operations/storage/statements",
   725	        headers=headers,
   726	        params={"year": 2026, "month": 7},
   727	    )
   728	    assert statement_response.status_code == 200, statement_response.text
   729	    statements = [
   730	        row
   731	        for row in statement_response.json()["statements"]
   732	        if row["id"] in {str(statement_id) for statement_id in statement_ids}
   733	    ]
   734	    assert len(statements) == 2
   735	    statement_kopecks = sum(
   736	        int((Decimal(row["total_amount"]) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1"))) for row in statements
   737	    )
   738	    allocated_kopecks = sum(
   739	        int((Decimal(measurement["amount"] or "0") * 100).quantize(Decimal("1")))
   740	        for row in statements
   741	        for measurement in row["measurements"]
   742	    )
   743	
   744	    details = await async_client.get(
   745	        f"/billing/seller-report/sellers/{seller_id}/details",
   746	        headers=headers,
   747	        params={
   748	            "date_from": period_start.isoformat(),
   749	            "date_to": period_end.isoformat(),
   750	            "include_finance": "true",
   751	        },
   752	    )
   753	    assert details.status_code == 200, details.text
   754	    report = details.json()["storage_row"]
   755	    invoice = await async_client.post(
   756	        "/billing/invoices-v2/preview",
   757	        headers=headers,
   758	        json={
   759	            "creation_mode": "selected_operations",
   760	            "seller_id": str(seller_id),
   761	            "date_from": period_start.isoformat(),
   762	            "date_to": period_end.isoformat(),
   763	            "selected_root_ids": [],
   764	            "storage_calculation_token": report["calculation_token"],
   765	        },
   766	    )
   767	    assert invoice.status_code == 200, invoice.text
   768	    assert report["liter_days"] == pytest.approx(0.0098)
   769	    assert report["amount_kopecks"] == invoice.json()["total_amount_kopecks"]
   770	    assert allocated_kopecks == statement_kopecks
   771	    assert statement_kopecks == report["amount_kopecks"] == invoice.json()["total_amount_kopecks"]

   774	@pytest.mark.asyncio
   775	async def test_warehouse_filter_preserves_cross_warehouse_fractional_allocation(
   776	    async_client: AsyncClient,
   777	) -> None:
   778	    """A1-CR-004: a display filter must not become a pricing-scope filter."""
   779	    headers, seller_id, warehouse_ids, statement_ids = (
   780	        await _create_cross_warehouse_fractional_storage_case(async_client)
   781	    )
   782	    period_start = date(2026, 7, 1)
   783	    period_end = date(2026, 7, 31)
   784	    unfiltered_response = await async_client.get(
   785	        "/operations/storage/statements",
   786	        headers=headers,
   787	        params={"year": 2026, "month": 7},
   788	    )
   789	    assert unfiltered_response.status_code == 200, unfiltered_response.text
   790	    statement_ids_as_str = {str(statement_id) for statement_id in statement_ids}
   791	    unfiltered = {
   792	        row["warehouse_id"]: row
   793	        for row in unfiltered_response.json()["statements"]
   794	        if row["id"] in statement_ids_as_str
   795	    }
   796	    assert set(unfiltered) == {str(warehouse_id) for warehouse_id in warehouse_ids}
   797	
   798	    for warehouse_id in warehouse_ids:
   799	        filtered_response = await async_client.get(
   800	            "/operations/storage/statements",
   801	            headers=headers,
   802	            params={"year": 2026, "month": 7, "warehouse_id": str(warehouse_id)},
   803	        )
   804	        assert filtered_response.status_code == 200, filtered_response.text
   805	        filtered = [
   806	            row
   807	            for row in filtered_response.json()["statements"]
   808	            if row["id"] in statement_ids_as_str
   809	        ]
   810	        assert len(filtered) == 1
   811	        assert filtered[0]["warehouse_id"] == str(warehouse_id)
   812	        # A warehouse filter only selects what the operator sees. It may not re-round it.
   813	        assert filtered[0]["total_amount"] == unfiltered[str(warehouse_id)]["total_amount"]
   814	        assert [
   815	            (row["product_id"], row["amount"], row["rate_snapshot"])
   816	            for row in filtered[0]["measurements"]
   817	        ] == [
   818	            (row["product_id"], row["amount"], row["rate_snapshot"])
   819	            for row in unfiltered[str(warehouse_id)]["measurements"]
   820	        ]
   821	
   822	    unfiltered_kopecks = sum(
   823	        int((Decimal(row["total_amount"]) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1")))
   824	        for row in unfiltered.values()
   825	    )
   826	    details = await async_client.get(
   827	        f"/billing/seller-report/sellers/{seller_id}/details",
   828	        headers=headers,
   829	        params={
   830	            "date_from": period_start.isoformat(),
   831	            "date_to": period_end.isoformat(),
   832	            "include_finance": "true",
   833	        },
   834	    )
   835	    assert details.status_code == 200, details.text
   836	    report = details.json()["storage_row"]
   837	    invoice = await async_client.post(
   838	        "/billing/invoices-v2/preview",
   839	        headers=headers,
   840	        json={
   841	            "creation_mode": "selected_operations",
   842	            "seller_id": str(seller_id),
   843	            "date_from": period_start.isoformat(),
   844	            "date_to": period_end.isoformat(),
   845	            "selected_root_ids": [],
   846	            "storage_calculation_token": report["calculation_token"],
   847	        },
   848	    )
   849	    assert invoice.status_code == 200, invoice.text
   850	    assert (
   851	        unfiltered_kopecks
   852	        == report["amount_kopecks"]
   853	        == invoice.json()["total_amount_kopecks"]
   854	        == 1
   855	    )

   200	async def _move_container_balances(
   201	    session: AsyncSession,
   202	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   203	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   204	    *,
   205	    refs: Iterable[tuple[str, uuid.UUID]],
   206	    destination_location_id: uuid.UUID,
   207	) -> None:
   208	    container_refs = list(refs)
   209	    if not container_refs:
   210	        return
   211	    predicates = [
   212	        and_(
   213	            InventoryBalance.container_kind == kind,
   214	            InventoryBalance.container_id == container_id,
   215	        )
   216	        for kind, container_id in container_refs
   217	    ]
   218	    result = await session.execute(
   219	        select(InventoryBalance, StorageLocation)
   220	        .join(StorageLocation, StorageLocation.id == InventoryBalance.storage_location_id)
   221	        .where(
   222	            InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   223	            or_(*predicates),
   224	        )
   225	        .with_for_update()
   226	    )
   227	    rows = list(result.all())
   228	    if any(
   229	        location.tenant_id != tenant_id or location.warehouse_id != warehouse_id
   230	        for _balance, location in rows
   231	    ):
   232	        raise PalletServiceError("container_wrong_warehouse")
   233	
   234	    grouped: dict[tuple[uuid.UUID, str, uuid.UUID], list[InventoryBalance]] = {}
   235	    for balance, _location in rows:
   236	        if balance.container_kind is None or balance.container_id is None:
   237	            continue
   238	        key = (balance.product_id, balance.container_kind, balance.container_id)
   239	        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(balance)
   240	
   241	    for balances in grouped.values():
   242	        target = next(
   243	            (
   244	                row
   245	                for row in balances
   246	                if row.storage_location_id == destination_location_id
   247	            ),
   248	            balances[0],
   249	        )
   250	        quantity = sum(int(row.quantity) for row in balances)
   251	        unpacked = sum(int(row.quantity_unpacked) for row in balances)
   252	        packed = sum(int(row.quantity_packed) for row in balances)
   253	        for row in balances:
   254	            if row is not target:
   255	                await session.delete(row)
   256	        await session.flush()
   257	        target.storage_location_id = destination_location_id
   258	        target.quantity = quantity
   259	        target.quantity_unpacked = unpacked
   260	        target.quantity_packed = packed
   261	        target.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
   262	        await session.flush()
   263	
   264	
   265	async def _detach_direct_pallet_balances(
   266	    session: AsyncSession,
   267	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   268	    pallet_id: uuid.UUID,
   269	    sorting_location_id: uuid.UUID,

   284	        .all()

   298	            )
   299	        ).scalar_one_or_none()
   300	        if target is None:

   302	            source.container_kind = None
   303	            source.container_id = None
   304	            source.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)

   308	        target.quantity_unpacked += source.quantity_unpacked
   309	        target.quantity_packed += source.quantity_packed
   310	        target.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
   311	        await session.delete(source)

   315	async def combine_into_pallet(
   316	    session: AsyncSession,
   317	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   318	    pallet_id: uuid.UUID,
   319	    *,
   320	    inbound_box_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   321	    cargo_place_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   322	    warehouse_box_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   323	) -> Pallet:
   324	    pallet = await _load_pallet(session, tenant_id, pallet_id, for_update=True)
   325	    if pallet.disbanded_at is not None:
   326	        raise PalletServiceError("pallet_disbanded")
   327	    inbound_ids = set(inbound_box_ids)
   328	    cargo_ids = set(cargo_place_ids)
   329	    warehouse_ids = set(warehouse_box_ids)
   330	    if not inbound_ids and not cargo_ids and not warehouse_ids:
   331	        raise PalletServiceError("containers_required")
   332	
   333	    inbound_boxes = await _load_inbound_boxes(
   334	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, inbound_ids
   335	    )
   336	    cargo_places = await _load_cargo_places(
   337	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, cargo_ids
   338	    )
   339	    warehouse_boxes = await _load_warehouse_boxes(
   340	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, warehouse_ids
   341	    )
   342	    destination = pallet.storage_location_id
   343	    if destination is None:
   344	        sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(
   345	            session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id
   346	        )
   347	        destination = sorting.id
   348	
   349	    for box in inbound_boxes:
   350	        box.pallet_id = pallet.id
   351	    for place in cargo_places:
   352	        place.pallet_id = pallet.id
   353	    for warehouse_box in warehouse_boxes:
   354	        warehouse_box.pallet_id = pallet.id
   355	        warehouse_box.storage_location_id = pallet.storage_location_id
   356	    await _move_container_balances(
   357	        session,

   361	            *(("box", box.id) for box in inbound_boxes),
   362	            *((box.container_kind, box.id) for box in warehouse_boxes),
   363	            *(("cargo_place", place.id) for place in cargo_places),
   364	        ],
   365	        destination_location_id=destination,
   366	    )
   367	    await session.commit()
   368	    await session.refresh(pallet)
   369	    return pallet

   372	async def disband_pallet(
   373	    session: AsyncSession,
   374	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   375	    pallet_id: uuid.UUID,
   376	) -> Pallet:
   377	    pallet = await _load_pallet(session, tenant_id, pallet_id, for_update=True)
   378	    if pallet.disbanded_at is not None:
   379	        raise PalletServiceError("pallet_disbanded")
   380	    sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(
   381	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id
   382	    )
   383	    inbound_boxes = list(
   384	        (
   385	            await session.execute(
   386	                select(InboundIntakeBox).where(
   387	                    InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   388	                    InboundIntakeBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   389	                )
   390	            )
   391	        )
   392	        .scalars()
   393	        .all()
   394	    )
   395	    cargo_places = list(
   396	        (
   397	            await session.execute(
   398	                select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace).where(
   399	                    InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   400	                    InboundIntakeCargoPlace.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   401	                )
   402	            )
   403	        )
   404	        .scalars()
   405	        .all()
   406	    )
   407	    warehouse_boxes = list(
   408	        (
   409	            await session.execute(
   410	                select(WarehouseBox).where(
   411	                    WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   412	                    WarehouseBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   413	                )
   414	            )
   415	        )
   416	        .scalars()
   417	        .all()
   418	    )
   419	    await _move_container_balances(
   420	        session,
   421	        tenant_id,
   422	        pallet.warehouse_id,
   423	        refs=[
   424	            *(("box", box.id) for box in inbound_boxes),
   425	            *((box.container_kind, box.id) for box in warehouse_boxes),
   426	            *(("cargo_place", place.id) for place in cargo_places),
   427	        ],
   428	        destination_location_id=sorting.id,
   429	    )
   430	    await _detach_direct_pallet_balances(
   431	        session, tenant_id, pallet.id, sorting.id
   432	    )
   433	    for box in inbound_boxes:
   434	        box.pallet_id = None
   435	    for place in cargo_places:
   436	        place.pallet_id = None
   437	    for warehouse_box in warehouse_boxes:
   438	        warehouse_box.pallet_id = None
   439	        warehouse_box.storage_location_id = None
   440	    pallet.storage_location_id = None
   441	    pallet.disbanded_at = datetime.now(UTC)
   442	    await session.commit()
   443	    await session.refresh(pallet)
   444	    return pallet

    74	async def resolve_container_paths(
    75	    session: AsyncSession,
    76	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
    77	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
    78	    container_refs: set[tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID]],
    79	) -> dict[tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID], tuple[WarehouseContainerPathItem, ...]]:
    80	    """Return map-compatible human container paths within one tenant warehouse."""
    81	    if not container_refs:
    82	        return {}
    83	    await _assert_warehouse(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
    84	    pallets = list(
    85	        (
    86	            await session.scalars(
    87	                select(Pallet).where(
    88	                    Pallet.tenant_id == tenant_id,
    89	                    Pallet.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
    90	                    Pallet.disbanded_at.is_(None),
    91	                )
    92	            )
    93	        ).all()
    94	    )
    95	    warehouse_boxes, inbound_boxes, cargo_places = await _load_boxes(
    96	        session, tenant_id, warehouse_id
    97	    )
    98	    pallet_by_id = {pallet.id: pallet for pallet in pallets}
    99	    warehouse_box_by_key: dict[tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID], WarehouseBox] = {
   100	        (box.container_kind, box.id): box for box in warehouse_boxes
   101	    }
   102	    inbound_box_by_id = {box.id: box for box in inbound_boxes}
   103	    cargo_place_by_id = {place.id: place for place in cargo_places}
   104	
   105	    paths: dict[
   106	        tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID], tuple[WarehouseContainerPathItem, ...]
   107	    ] = {}
   108	    for ref in container_refs:
   109	        kind, container_id = ref
   110	        if kind == "pallet":
   111	            pallet = pallet_by_id.get(container_id)
   112	            if pallet is None:
   113	                raise WarehouseMapError("container_not_found")
   114	            paths[ref] = (_container_path_item("pallet", pallet.id, pallet.code),)
   115	            continue
   116	
   117	        code: str
   118	        parent_pallet_id: uuid.UUID | None
   119	        warehouse_box = warehouse_box_by_key.get(ref)
   120	        if warehouse_box is not None:
   121	            code = warehouse_box.internal_barcode
   122	            parent_pallet_id = warehouse_box.pallet_id
   123	        elif kind == "box" and container_id in inbound_box_by_id:
   124	            inbound_box = inbound_box_by_id[container_id]
   125	            code = f"КР-{inbound_box.box_number:06d}"
   126	            parent_pallet_id = inbound_box.pallet_id
   127	        elif kind == "cargo_place" and container_id in cargo_place_by_id:
   128	            cargo_place = cargo_place_by_id[container_id]
   129	            code = f"ГМ-{cargo_place.place_number:06d}"
   130	            parent_pallet_id = cargo_place.pallet_id
   131	        else:
   132	            raise WarehouseMapError("container_not_found")
   133	
   134	        path: list[WarehouseContainerPathItem] = []
   135	        if parent_pallet_id is not None:
   136	            parent = pallet_by_id.get(parent_pallet_id)
   137	            if parent is None:
   138	                raise WarehouseMapError("container_not_found")
   139	            path.append(_container_path_item("pallet", parent.id, parent.code))
   140	        path.append(_container_path_item(kind, container_id, code))
   141	        paths[ref] = tuple(path)
   142	    return paths

   203	async def _load_map_rows(
   204	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, warehouse_id: uuid.UUID
   205	) -> tuple[
   206	    list[tuple[InventoryBalance, StorageLocation, Product, Seller | None]],
   207	    list[StorageLocation],
   208	    list[Pallet],
   209	    list[WarehouseBox],
   210	    list[InboundIntakeBox],
   211	    list[InboundIntakeCargoPlace],
   212	    dict[tuple[uuid.UUID, int], SellerWildberriesImportedCard],
   213	]:
   214	    rows = cast(
   215	        list[tuple[InventoryBalance, StorageLocation, Product, Seller | None]],
   216	        list(

   222	                    )
   223	                    .join(Product, Product.id == InventoryBalance.product_id)
   224	                    .outerjoin(Seller, Seller.id == Product.seller_id)
   225	                    .where(
   226	                        InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   227	                        InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   228	                        StorageLocation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   229	                        StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   230	                        Product.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   231	                    )
   232	                )
   233	            ).all()
   234	        ),
   235	    )
   236	    locations = list(
   237	        (
   238	            await session.scalars(
   239	                select(StorageLocation)
   240	                .where(
   241	                    StorageLocation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   242	                    StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   243	                    StorageLocation.deleted_at.is_(None),
   244	                )
   245	                .order_by(StorageLocation.code)
   246	            )
   247	        ).all()
   248	    )
   249	    pallets = list(
   250	        (
   251	            await session.scalars(
   252	                select(Pallet)
   253	                .where(
   254	                    Pallet.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   255	                    Pallet.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   256	                    Pallet.disbanded_at.is_(None),
   257	                )
   258	                .order_by(Pallet.code)
   259	            )
   260	        ).all()
   261	    )
   262	    warehouse_boxes, inbound_boxes, cargo_places = await _load_boxes(
   263	        session, tenant_id, warehouse_id
   264	    )
   265	    pairs = {
   266	        (product.seller_id, product.wb_nm_id)
   267	        for _balance, _location, product, _seller in rows
   268	        if product.seller_id is not None and product.wb_nm_id is not None
   269	    }
   270	    cards: dict[tuple[uuid.UUID, int], SellerWildberriesImportedCard] = {}
   271	    if pairs:
   272	        seller_ids = {pair[0] for pair in pairs}
   273	        nm_ids = {pair[1] for pair in pairs}
   274	        card_rows = await session.scalars(
   275	            select(SellerWildberriesImportedCard).where(
   276	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   277	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.seller_id.in_(seller_ids),
   278	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.nm_id.in_(nm_ids),

   283	        rows,

   293	def _normalize_container(node: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   294	    children = [
   295	        _normalize_container(child) if child["kind"] != "product" else child
   296	        for child in node["children"]
   297	    ]
   298	    sellers: set[str] = set()
   299	
   300	    def collect(child: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   301	        if child["kind"] == "product":
   302	            if child["seller_name"]:
   303	                sellers.add(child["seller_name"])
   304	            return
   305	        for nested in child["children"]:
   306	            collect(nested)
   307	
   308	    for child in children:
   309	        collect(child)
   310	    return {
   311	        **node,
   312	        "children": children,
   313	        "qty": sum(int(child["qty"]) for child in children),
   314	        "seller_name": next(iter(sellers)) if len(sellers) == 1 else None,
   315	    }

   318	async def get_warehouse_map(
   319	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, warehouse_id: uuid.UUID
   320	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   321	    await _assert_warehouse(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   322	    address_enabled = await is_address_storage_enabled(session, tenant_id)
   323	    (
   324	        rows,
   325	        locations,
   326	        pallets,
   327	        warehouse_boxes,
   328	        inbound_boxes,
   329	        cargo_places,
   330	        cards,
   331	    ) = await _load_map_rows(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   332	
   333	    location_by_id = {location.id: location for location in locations}
   334	    balance_location: dict[tuple[str, uuid.UUID], uuid.UUID] = {}
   335	    for balance, location, _product, _seller in rows:
   336	        if balance.container_kind and balance.container_id:
   337	            balance_location.setdefault((balance.container_kind, balance.container_id), location.id)
   338	
   339	    nodes: dict[tuple[str, uuid.UUID], dict[str, Any]] = {}

   341	    pallet_ids = {pallet.id for pallet in pallets}
   342	    for pallet in pallets:
   343	        key = ("pallet", pallet.id)
   344	        nodes[key] = {
   345	            "kind": "pallet",
   346	            "id": str(pallet.id),
   347	            "code": pallet.code,
   348	            "barcode": pallet.barcode,
   349	            "seller_name": None,
   350	            "qty": 0,
   351	            "children": [],
   352	        }
   353	        holders[key] = pallet.storage_location_id
   354	    for box in warehouse_boxes:
   355	        key = (box.container_kind, box.id)
   356	        nodes[key] = {
   357	            "kind": box.container_kind,
   358	            "id": str(box.id),
   359	            "code": box.internal_barcode,
   360	            "barcode": box.internal_barcode,
   361	            "seller_name": None,
   362	            "qty": 0,
   363	            "children": [],
   364	        }
   365	        holders[key] = (
   366	            ("pallet", box.pallet_id)
   367	            if box.pallet_id in pallet_ids
   368	            else box.storage_location_id or balance_location.get(key)
   369	        )
   370	    for inbound_box in inbound_boxes:
   371	        key = ("box", inbound_box.id)
   372	        nodes[key] = {
   373	            "kind": "box",
   374	            "id": str(inbound_box.id),
   375	            "code": f"КР-{inbound_box.box_number:06d}",
   376	            "barcode": inbound_box.internal_barcode,
   377	            "seller_name": None,
   378	            "qty": 0,
   379	            "children": [],
   380	        }
   381	        holders[key] = (
   382	            ("pallet", inbound_box.pallet_id)
   383	            if inbound_box.pallet_id in pallet_ids
   384	            else balance_location.get(key)
   385	        )
   386	    for place in cargo_places:
   387	        key = ("cargo_place", place.id)
   388	        nodes[key] = {
   389	            "kind": "cargo_place",
   390	            "id": str(place.id),
   391	            "code": f"ГМ-{place.place_number:06d}",
   392	            "barcode": place.internal_barcode,
   393	            "seller_name": None,
   394	            "qty": 0,
   395	            "children": [],
   396	        }
   397	        holders[key] = (
   398	            ("pallet", place.pallet_id)
   399	            if place.pallet_id in pallet_ids
   400	            else balance_location.get(key)
   401	        )
   402	
   403	    loose_by_location: dict[uuid.UUID, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
   404	    sellers: set[str] = set()
   405	    categories: set[str] = set()
   406	    for balance, location, product, seller in rows:
   407	        card = (
   408	            cards.get((product.seller_id, product.wb_nm_id))
   409	            if (product.seller_id is not None and product.wb_nm_id is not None)
   410	            else None
   411	        )
   412	        category, photo_url = _card_data(card)
   413	        seller_name = seller.name if seller is not None else None
   414	        if seller_name:
   415	            sellers.add(seller_name)
   416	        if category:
   417	            categories.add(category)
   418	        product_node = {
   419	            "kind": "product",
   420	            "id": str(balance.id),
   421	            "product_id": str(product.id),
   422	            "name": product.name,
   423	            "seller_name": seller_name,
   424	            "category": category,
   425	            "barcode": product.wb_barcode,
   426	            "photo_url": photo_url,
   427	            "qty": int(balance.quantity),
   428	        }
   429	        container_key = (
   430	            (balance.container_kind, balance.container_id)
   431	            if balance.container_kind and balance.container_id
   432	            else None
   433	        )
   434	        if container_key in nodes:
   435	            assert container_key is not None
   436	            nodes[container_key]["children"].append(product_node)
   437	        else:
   438	            loose_by_location[location.id].append(product_node)
   439	
   440	    root_by_location: dict[uuid.UUID, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
   441	    unassigned: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   442	    for key, node in nodes.items():
   443	        holder = holders.get(key)
   444	        if isinstance(holder, tuple) and holder in nodes:
   445	            nodes[holder]["children"].append(node)
   446	            continue
   447	        root_location = location_by_id.get(holder) if isinstance(holder, uuid.UUID) else None
   448	        if (
   449	            address_enabled
   450	            and root_location is not None
   451	            and root_location.code != SORTING_LOCATION_CODE
   452	        ):
   453	            root_by_location[root_location.id].append(node)
   454	        else:
   455	            unassigned.append(node)
   456	
   457	    cells: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   458	    if address_enabled:
   459	        for location in locations:
   460	            if location.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE:
   461	                unassigned.extend(loose_by_location.pop(location.id, []))
   462	                continue
   463	            children = [
   464	                *root_by_location.get(location.id, []),
   465	                *loose_by_location.pop(location.id, []),
   466	            ]
   467	            normalized = [
   468	                _normalize_container(child) if child["kind"] != "product" else child
   469	                for child in children
   470	            ]
   471	            cells.append(
   472	                {
   473	                    "id": str(location.id),
   474	                    "code": location.code,
   475	                    "barcode": location.barcode,
   476	                    "qty": sum(int(child["qty"]) for child in normalized),
   477	                    "children": normalized,
   478	                }
   479	            )
   480	    else:
   481	        for loose in loose_by_location.values():
   482	            unassigned.extend(loose)
   483	    normalized_unassigned = [
   484	        _normalize_container(node) if node["kind"] != "product" else node for node in unassigned
   485	    ]
   486	
   487	    warehouses = list(
   488	        (
   489	            await session.scalars(
   490	                select(Warehouse)
   491	                .where(
   492	                    Warehouse.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   493	                    Warehouse.is_operational.is_(True),
   494	                )
   495	                .order_by(Warehouse.name)
   496	            )
   497	        ).all()
   498	    )
   499	    event_rows = list(
   500	        (
   501	            await session.execute(
   502	                select(WarehouseMapEvent, User)
   503	                .outerjoin(User, User.id == WarehouseMapEvent.actor_user_id)
   504	                .where(
   505	                    WarehouseMapEvent.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   506	                    WarehouseMapEvent.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   507	                )
   508	                .order_by(WarehouseMapEvent.created_at.desc(), WarehouseMapEvent.id.desc())
   509	                .limit(100)
   510	            )
   511	        ).all()
   512	    )
   513	    journal = [
   514	        {
   515	            "id": str(event.id),
   516	            "at": event.created_at.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
   517	            "actor_name": actor.email if actor is not None else "Система",
   518	            "subject": event.subject,
   519	            "qty": event.quantity,
   520	            "from_label": event.from_label,
   521	            "to_label": event.to_label,
   522	        }
   523	        for event, actor in event_rows
   524	    ]
   525	    return {
   526	        "warehouses": [{"id": str(row.id), "name": row.name} for row in warehouses],
   527	        "sellers": sorted(sellers),
   528	        "categories": sorted(categories),
   529	        "cells": cells,
   530	        "unassigned": normalized_unassigned,
   531	        "journal": journal,
   532	    }
   533	
   534	
   535	async def _container_location_id(
   536	    session: AsyncSession,
   537	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   538	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   539	    kind: ContainerKind,
   540	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   541	) -> uuid.UUID:
   542	    await validate_container(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, kind, container_id)
   543	    if kind == "pallet":
   544	        pallet = await session.get(Pallet, container_id)
   545	        assert pallet is not None
   546	        if pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   547	            return pallet.storage_location_id
   548	    if kind == "box":
   549	        box = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   550	        if (
   551	            box is not None
   552	            and box.tenant_id == tenant_id
   553	            and box.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   554	            and box.container_kind == kind
   555	        ):
   556	            if box.pallet_id is not None:
   557	                pallet = await session.get(Pallet, box.pallet_id)
   558	                if pallet is not None and pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   559	                    return pallet.storage_location_id
   560	            if box.storage_location_id is not None:
   561	                return box.storage_location_id
   562	    if kind == "cargo_place":
   563	        cargo_place = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   564	        if (
   565	            cargo_place is not None
   566	            and cargo_place.tenant_id == tenant_id
   567	            and cargo_place.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   568	            and cargo_place.container_kind == kind
   569	        ):
   570	            if cargo_place.pallet_id is not None:
   571	                pallet = await session.get(Pallet, cargo_place.pallet_id)
   572	                if pallet is not None and pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   573	                    return pallet.storage_location_id
   574	            if cargo_place.storage_location_id is not None:
   575	                return cargo_place.storage_location_id
   576	    balance_location = await session.scalar(
   577	        select(InventoryBalance.storage_location_id)
   578	        .where(
   579	            InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   580	            InventoryBalance.container_kind == kind,
   581	            InventoryBalance.container_id == container_id,
   582	            InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   583	        )
   584	        .limit(1)
   585	    )
   586	    if balance_location is not None:
   587	        location = await session.get(StorageLocation, balance_location)
   588	        if location is not None and location.warehouse_id == warehouse_id:
   589	            return balance_location
   590	    sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   591	    return sorting.id
   592	
   593	
   594	async def _destination(
   595	    session: AsyncSession,
   596	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   597	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   598	    to_kind: DestinationKind,
   599	    to_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   600	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID, ContainerKind | None, uuid.UUID | None, str]:
   601	    if to_kind == "cell":
   602	        if not await is_address_storage_enabled(session, tenant_id):
   603	            raise WarehouseMapError("address_storage_disabled")
   604	        if to_id is None:
   605	            raise WarehouseMapError("destination_required")
   606	        location = await session.get(StorageLocation, to_id)
   607	        if (
   608	            location is None
   609	            or location.tenant_id != tenant_id
   610	            or location.warehouse_id != warehouse_id
   611	            or location.deleted_at is not None
   612	            or location.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE
   613	        ):
   614	            raise WarehouseMapError("cell_not_found")
   615	        return location.id, None, None, f"Ячейка {location.code}"
   616	    if to_kind in {"unassigned", "sorting"}:
   617	        sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   618	        return sorting.id, None, None, UNASSIGNED_LABEL
   619	    if to_id is None:
   620	        raise WarehouseMapError("destination_required")
   621	    container_kind = cast(ContainerKind, to_kind)
   622	    try:
   623	        location_id = await _container_location_id(
   624	            session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, to_id
   625	        )
   626	    except ValueError as exc:
   627	        raise WarehouseMapError("destination_not_found") from exc
   628	    code = await _container_code(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, to_id)
   629	    return location_id, container_kind, to_id, _container_title(container_kind, code)
   630	
   631	
   632	async def _container_code(
   633	    session: AsyncSession,
   634	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   635	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   636	    kind: ContainerKind,
   637	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   638	) -> str:
   639	    if kind == "pallet":
   640	        row = await session.get(Pallet, container_id)
   641	        if row is not None and row.tenant_id == tenant_id and row.warehouse_id == warehouse_id:
   642	            return row.code
   643	    elif kind == "box":
   644	        warehouse_box = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   645	        if (
   646	            warehouse_box is not None
   647	            and warehouse_box.tenant_id == tenant_id
   648	            and warehouse_box.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   649	            and warehouse_box.container_kind == "box"
   650	        ):
   651	            return warehouse_box.internal_barcode
   652	        inbound = await session.scalar(
   653	            select(InboundIntakeBox)
   654	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   655	            .where(
   656	                InboundIntakeBox.id == container_id,
   657	                InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   658	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   659	            )
   660	        )
   661	        if inbound is not None:
   662	            return f"КР-{inbound.box_number:06d}"
   663	    else:
   664	        warehouse_cargo_place = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   665	        if (
   666	            warehouse_cargo_place is not None
   667	            and warehouse_cargo_place.tenant_id == tenant_id
   668	            and warehouse_cargo_place.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   669	            and warehouse_cargo_place.container_kind == "cargo_place"
   670	        ):
   671	            return warehouse_cargo_place.internal_barcode
   672	        cargo = await session.scalar(
   673	            select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace)
   674	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   675	            .where(
   676	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.id == container_id,
   677	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   678	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   679	            )
   680	        )
   681	        if cargo is not None:
   682	            return f"ГМ-{cargo.place_number:06d}"
   683	    raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   684	
   685	
   686	async def _location_label(session: AsyncSession, location_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
   687	    location = await session.get(StorageLocation, location_id)
   688	    if location is None or location.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE:
   689	        return UNASSIGNED_LABEL
   690	    return f"Ячейка {location.code}"
   691	
   692	
   693	async def _transfer_balance(
   694	    session: AsyncSession,
   695	    *,
   696	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   697	    balance: InventoryBalance,
   698	    quantity: int,
   699	    destination_location_id: uuid.UUID,
   700	    destination_container_kind: ContainerKind | None,
   701	    destination_container_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   702	    transfer_group_id: uuid.UUID,
   703	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID,
   704	) -> None:
   705	    source_kind = cast(ContainerKind | None, balance.container_kind)
   706	    await inventory_service.record_movement_and_adjust_balance(
   707	        session,
   708	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
   709	        product_id=balance.product_id,
   710	        storage_location_id=balance.storage_location_id,
   711	        quantity_delta=-quantity,
   712	        movement_type=MOVEMENT_TYPE_WAREHOUSE_MAP,
   713	        transfer_group_id=transfer_group_id,
   714	        container_kind=source_kind,
   715	        container_id=balance.container_id,
   716	        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   717	    )
   718	    await inventory_service.record_movement_and_adjust_balance(
   719	        session,
   720	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
   721	        product_id=balance.product_id,
   722	        storage_location_id=destination_location_id,
   723	        quantity_delta=quantity,
   724	        movement_type=MOVEMENT_TYPE_WAREHOUSE_MAP,
   725	        transfer_group_id=transfer_group_id,
   726	        container_kind=destination_container_kind,
   727	        container_id=destination_container_id,
   728	        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   729	    )
   730	
   731	
   732	async def _container_balances(
   733	    session: AsyncSession,
   734	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   735	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   736	    kind: ContainerKind,
   737	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   738	) -> list[InventoryBalance]:
   739	    refs: list[tuple[str, uuid.UUID]] = [(kind, container_id)]
   740	    if kind == "pallet":
   741	        warehouse_boxes, inbound_boxes, cargo_places = await _load_boxes(
   742	            session, tenant_id, warehouse_id
   743	        )
   744	        refs.extend(
   745	            (row.container_kind, row.id)
   746	            for row in warehouse_boxes
   747	            if row.pallet_id == container_id
   748	        )
   749	        refs.extend(("box", row.id) for row in inbound_boxes if row.pallet_id == container_id)
   750	        refs.extend(
   751	            ("cargo_place", row.id) for row in cargo_places if row.pallet_id == container_id
   752	        )
   753	    predicates = [
   754	        (InventoryBalance.container_kind == ref_kind) & (InventoryBalance.container_id == ref_id)
   755	        for ref_kind, ref_id in refs
   756	    ]
   757	    rows = list(
   758	        (
   759	            await session.scalars(
   760	                select(InventoryBalance)
   761	                .join(StorageLocation)
   762	                .where(
   763	                    InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   764	                    InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   765	                    StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   766	                    or_(*predicates),
   767	                )
   768	                .with_for_update()
   769	            )
   770	        ).all()
   771	    )
   772	    return rows
   773	
   774	
   775	async def _place_container(
   776	    session: AsyncSession,
   777	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   778	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   779	    kind: ContainerKind,
   780	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   781	    to_kind: DestinationKind,
   782	    to_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   783	    destination_location_id: uuid.UUID,
   784	) -> None:
   785	    if kind == "pallet":
   786	        if to_kind not in {"cell", "unassigned", "sorting"}:
   787	            raise WarehouseMapError("invalid_container_destination")
   788	        pallet = await session.get(Pallet, container_id)
   789	        if (
   790	            pallet is None
   791	            or pallet.tenant_id != tenant_id
   792	            or pallet.warehouse_id != warehouse_id
   793	            or pallet.disbanded_at is not None
   794	        ):
   795	            raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   796	        pallet.storage_location_id = destination_location_id if to_kind == "cell" else None
   797	        return
   798	    if to_kind not in {"cell", "unassigned", "sorting", "pallet"}:
   799	        raise WarehouseMapError("invalid_container_destination")
   800	    pallet_id = to_id if to_kind == "pallet" else None
   801	    if pallet_id == container_id:
   802	        raise WarehouseMapError("container_cycle")
   803	    if kind == "box":
   804	        warehouse_box = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   805	        if (
   806	            warehouse_box is not None
   807	            and warehouse_box.tenant_id == tenant_id
   808	            and warehouse_box.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   809	            and warehouse_box.container_kind == "box"
   810	        ):
   811	            warehouse_box.pallet_id = pallet_id
   812	            warehouse_box.storage_location_id = (
   813	                destination_location_id if to_kind == "cell" else None
   814	            )
   815	            return
   816	        inbound = await session.scalar(
   817	            select(InboundIntakeBox)
   818	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   819	            .where(
   820	                InboundIntakeBox.id == container_id,
   821	                InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   822	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   823	            )
   824	        )
   825	        if inbound is None:
   826	            raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   827	        inbound.pallet_id = pallet_id
   828	        return
   829	    warehouse_cargo_place = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   830	    if (
   831	        warehouse_cargo_place is not None
   832	        and warehouse_cargo_place.tenant_id == tenant_id
   833	        and warehouse_cargo_place.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   834	        and warehouse_cargo_place.container_kind == "cargo_place"
   835	    ):
   836	        warehouse_cargo_place.pallet_id = pallet_id
   837	        warehouse_cargo_place.storage_location_id = (
   838	            destination_location_id if to_kind == "cell" else None
   839	        )
   840	        return
   841	    cargo = await session.scalar(
   842	        select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace)
   843	        .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   844	        .where(
   845	            InboundIntakeCargoPlace.id == container_id,
   846	            InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   847	            InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   848	        )
   849	    )
   850	    if cargo is None:
   851	        raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   852	    cargo.pallet_id = pallet_id
   853	
   854	
   855	async def move_object(
   856	    session: AsyncSession,
   857	    *,
   858	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   859	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   860	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID,
   861	    kind: ObjectKind,
   862	    object_id: uuid.UUID,
   863	    to_kind: DestinationKind,
   864	    to_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   865	    quantity: int,
   866	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   867	    await _assert_warehouse(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   868	    if quantity <= 0:
   869	        raise WarehouseMapError("quantity_must_be_positive")
   870	    if kind == "pallet" and to_kind == "pallet" and object_id == to_id:
   871	        raise WarehouseMapError("container_cycle")
   872	    destination_location_id, destination_kind, destination_id, to_label = await _destination(
   873	        session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, to_kind, to_id
   874	    )
   875	    transfer_group_id = uuid.uuid4()
   876	
   877	    if kind == "product":
   878	        balance = await session.scalar(
   879	            select(InventoryBalance)
   880	            .join(StorageLocation)
   881	            .where(
   882	                InventoryBalance.id == object_id,
   883	                InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   884	                InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   885	                StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   886	            )
   887	            .with_for_update()
   888	        )
   889	        if balance is None:
   890	            raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   891	        if quantity > balance.quantity:
   892	            raise WarehouseMapError("insufficient_stock")
   893	        product = await session.get(Product, balance.product_id)
   894	        assert product is not None
   895	        from_label = await _location_label(session, balance.storage_location_id)
   896	        if balance.container_kind and balance.container_id:
   897	            code = await _container_code(
   898	                session,
   899	                tenant_id,
   900	                warehouse_id,
   901	                cast(ContainerKind, balance.container_kind),
   902	                balance.container_id,
   903	            )
   904	            from_label = _container_title(balance.container_kind, code)
   905	        await _transfer_balance(
   906	            session,
   907	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
   908	            balance=balance,
   909	            quantity=quantity,
   910	            destination_location_id=destination_location_id,
   911	            destination_container_kind=destination_kind,
   912	            destination_container_id=destination_id,
   913	            transfer_group_id=transfer_group_id,
   914	            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   915	        )
   916	        subject = product.name
   917	        moved_quantity: int | None = quantity
   918	    else:
   919	        container_kind: ContainerKind = kind
   920	        try:
   921	            await validate_container(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, object_id)
   922	        except ValueError as exc:
   923	            raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found") from exc
   924	        if to_kind in {"box", "cargo_place"}:
   925	            raise WarehouseMapError("invalid_container_destination")
   926	        source_location_id = await _container_location_id(
   927	            session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, object_id
   928	        )
   929	        from_label = await _location_label(session, source_location_id)
   930	        balances = await _container_balances(
   931	            session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, object_id
   932	        )
   933	        moved_total = sum(int(row.quantity) for row in balances)
   934	        for balance in balances:
   935	            await _transfer_balance(
   936	                session,
   937	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   938	                balance=balance,
   939	                quantity=int(balance.quantity),
   940	                destination_location_id=destination_location_id,
   941	                destination_container_kind=cast(ContainerKind, balance.container_kind),
   942	                destination_container_id=balance.container_id,
   943	                transfer_group_id=transfer_group_id,
   944	                actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   945	            )
   946	        await _place_container(
   947	            session,
   948	            tenant_id,
   949	            warehouse_id,
   950	            container_kind,
   951	            object_id,
   952	            to_kind,
   953	            to_id,
   954	            destination_location_id,
   955	        )
   956	        code = await _container_code(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, object_id)
   957	        subject = _container_title(container_kind, code)
   958	        moved_quantity = moved_total
   959	
   960	    event = WarehouseMapEvent(
   961	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
   962	        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   963	        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   964	        subject=subject,
   965	        quantity=moved_quantity,
   966	        from_label=from_label,
   967	        to_label=to_label,
   968	    )
   969	    session.add(event)
   970	    await session.commit()
   971	    return {"id": str(event.id), "moved_qty": moved_quantity}
   972	
   973	
   974	async def create_sorting_object(
   975	    session: AsyncSession,
   976	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   977	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   978	    *,
   979	    kind: Literal["pallet", "box", "cargo_place"],
   980	) -> dict[str, str | None]:
   981	    await _assert_warehouse(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   982	    if kind == "pallet":
   983	        try:
   984	            pallet = await pallet_service.create_pallet(
   985	                session,
   986	                tenant_id,
   987	                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   988	            )
   989	        except pallet_service.PalletServiceError as exc:
   990	            raise WarehouseMapError(exc.code) from exc
   991	        return {
   992	            "id": str(pallet.id),
   993	            "kind": kind,
   994	            "code": pallet.code,
   995	            "barcode": pallet.barcode,
   996	            "holder": None,
   997	        }
   998	
   999	    try:
  1000	        container = await warehouse_box_service.create_warehouse_box(
  1001	            session,
  1002	            tenant_id,
  1003	            warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
  1004	            container_kind=kind,
  1005	        )
  1006	        await session.commit()
  1007	        await session.refresh(container)
  1008	    except warehouse_box_service.WarehouseBoxError as exc:
  1009	        await session.rollback()
  1010	        raise WarehouseMapError(exc.code) from exc
  1011	    return {
  1012	        "id": str(container.id),
  1013	        "kind": kind,
  1014	        "code": container.internal_barcode,
  1015	        "barcode": container.internal_barcode,
  1016	        "holder": None,
  1017	    }
  1018	
  1019	
  1020	async def disband_pallet(
  1021	    session: AsyncSession,

  1064	    holder: str | None,
  1065	    objects: list[dict[str, Any]],

  1074	                    "qty": node["qty"],
  1075	                    "holder": holder,
  1076	                }
  1077	            )
  1078	            continue
  1079	        object_holder = f"obj:{node['id']}"
  1080	        objects.append(
  1081	            {
  1082	                "id": node["id"],
  1083	                "kind": node["kind"],
  1084	                "code": node["code"],
  1085	                "barcode": node["barcode"] or "",
  1086	                "holder": holder,
  1087	            }
  1088	        )
  1089	        _sorting_tree_rows(node["children"], holder=object_holder, objects=objects, lines=lines)

   108	async def _container_scope(
   109	    session: AsyncSession,
   110	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   111	    kind: ContainerKind,
   112	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   113	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID, list[tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID]]]:
   114	    refs: list[tuple[ContainerKind, uuid.UUID]] = [(kind, container_id)]
   115	    if kind == "pallet":
   116	        pallet = await session.scalar(
   117	            select(Pallet).where(
   118	                Pallet.id == container_id,
   119	                Pallet.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   120	                Pallet.disbanded_at.is_(None),
   121	            )
   122	        )
   123	        if pallet is None:
   124	            raise InventoryCountError("object_not_found")
   125	        warehouse_id = pallet.warehouse_id
   126	        warehouse_containers = await session.scalars(
   127	            select(WarehouseBox).where(
   128	                WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   129	                WarehouseBox.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   130	                WarehouseBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   131	            )
   132	        )
   133	        inbound_box_ids = await session.scalars(
   134	            select(InboundIntakeBox.id)
   135	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   136	            .where(
   137	                InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   138	                InboundIntakeBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   139	                InboundIntakeRequest.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   140	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   141	            )
   142	        )
   143	        cargo_place_ids = await session.scalars(
   144	            select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace.id)
   145	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   146	            .where(
   147	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   148	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   149	                InboundIntakeRequest.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   150	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   151	            )
   152	        )
   153	        refs.extend((row.container_kind, row.id) for row in warehouse_containers.all())
   154	        refs.extend(("box", row_id) for row_id in inbound_box_ids.all())
   155	        refs.extend(("cargo_place", row_id) for row_id in cargo_place_ids.all())
   156	        return warehouse_id, refs
   157	
   158	    if kind == "box":
   159	        warehouse_box = await session.scalar(
   160	            select(WarehouseBox).where(
   161	                WarehouseBox.id == container_id,
   162	                WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   163	                WarehouseBox.container_kind == "box",
   164	            )
   165	        )
   166	        if warehouse_box is not None:
   167	            return warehouse_box.warehouse_id, refs
   168	        request_warehouse_id = await session.scalar(
   169	            select(InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id)
   170	            .join(InboundIntakeBox)
   171	            .where(
   172	                InboundIntakeBox.id == container_id,
   173	                InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   174	                InboundIntakeRequest.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   175	            )
   176	        )
   177	    else:
   178	        warehouse_cargo_place = await session.scalar(
   179	            select(WarehouseBox).where(
   180	                WarehouseBox.id == container_id,
   181	                WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   182	                WarehouseBox.container_kind == "cargo_place",
   183	            )
   184	        )
   185	        if warehouse_cargo_place is not None:
   186	            return warehouse_cargo_place.warehouse_id, refs
   187	        request_warehouse_id = await session.scalar(
   188	            select(InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id)
   189	            .join(InboundIntakeCargoPlace)
   190	            .where(
   191	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.id == container_id,
   192	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   193	                InboundIntakeRequest.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   194	            )
   195	        )
   196	    if request_warehouse_id is None:
   197	        raise InventoryCountError("object_not_found")
   198	    return request_warehouse_id, refs

   201	def _balance_query(
   202	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   203	    *,
   204	    seller_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   205	    category: str | None,
   206	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   207	    address_storage_enabled: bool,
   208	) -> Select[tuple[InventoryBalance, Product, StorageLocation]]:
   209	    stmt = (
   210	        select(InventoryBalance, Product, StorageLocation)
   211	        .join(Product, Product.id == InventoryBalance.product_id)
   212	        .join(StorageLocation, StorageLocation.id == InventoryBalance.storage_location_id)
   213	        .where(
   214	            InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   215	            Product.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   216	            StorageLocation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   217	            StorageLocation.deleted_at.is_(None),
   218	            InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   219	        )
   220	        .options(selectinload(Product.seller))
   221	        .order_by(StorageLocation.code, Product.sku_code)
   222	    )
   223	    if seller_id is not None:
   224	        stmt = stmt.where(Product.seller_id == seller_id)
   225	    if warehouse_id is not None:
   226	        stmt = stmt.where(StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
   227	    if not address_storage_enabled:
   228	        stmt = stmt.where(StorageLocation.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE)
   229	    if category is not None:
   230	        # Категория товара приходит из двух мест: собственное поле каталога и
   231	        # карточка Wildberries. У импортированных товаров заполнено одно, у
   232	        # заведённых руками — другое, поэтому ищем по обоим. Смотреть только в
   233	        # собственное поле значит потерять всё, что приехало импортом.
   234	        stmt = stmt.outerjoin(
   235	            SellerWildberriesImportedCard,
   236	            and_(
   237	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   238	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.seller_id == Product.seller_id,
   239	                SellerWildberriesImportedCard.nm_id == Product.wb_nm_id,
   240	            ),
   241	        )
   242	        card_matches = _card_category_expression() == category
   243	        category_column = _product_category_column()
   244	        stmt = stmt.where(
   245	            or_(category_column == category, card_matches)
   246	            if category_column is not None
   247	            else card_matches
   248	        )
   249	    return stmt
   250
