   252	async def create_count(
   253	    session: AsyncSession,
   254	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   255	    user_id: uuid.UUID,
   256	    *,
   257	    source: str,
   258	    object_scope: CountObject | None,
   259	    filters: CountFilters | None,
   260	    comment: str | None,
   261	) -> InventoryCount:
   262	    if source not in {SOURCE_OBJECT, SOURCE_PLANNED}:
   263	        raise InventoryCountError("invalid_source")
   264	    if source == SOURCE_OBJECT and object_scope is None:
   265	        raise InventoryCountError("object_required")
   266	    if source == SOURCE_PLANNED and filters is None:
   267	        raise InventoryCountError("filters_required")
   268	
   269	    seller_id = filters.seller_id if filters is not None else None
   270	    category = filters.category.strip() if filters and filters.category else None
   271	    warehouse_id = filters.warehouse_id if filters is not None else None
   272	    await _validate_scope(
   273	        session,
   274	        tenant_id,
   275	        seller_id=seller_id,
   276	        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   277	    )
   278	    address_enabled = await tenant_settings_service.is_address_storage_enabled(
   279	        session, tenant_id
   280	    )
   281	    stmt = _balance_query(
   282	        tenant_id,
   283	        seller_id=seller_id,
   284	        category=category,
   285	        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   286	        address_storage_enabled=address_enabled,
   287	    )
   288	
   289	    container_object = False
   290	    if object_scope is not None:
   291	        if object_scope.type in {"storage_location", "location", "cell"}:
   292	            location = await session.get(StorageLocation, object_scope.id)
   293	            if location is None or location.tenant_id != tenant_id:
   294	                raise InventoryCountError("object_not_found")
   295	            if not address_enabled:
   296	                raise InventoryCountError("object_not_available_without_address_storage")
   297	            warehouse_id = location.warehouse_id
   298	            stmt = stmt.where(InventoryBalance.storage_location_id == location.id)
   299	        elif object_scope.type == "product":
   300	            product = await session.get(Product, object_scope.id)
   301	            if product is None or product.tenant_id != tenant_id:
   302	                raise InventoryCountError("object_not_found")
   303	            stmt = stmt.where(Product.id == product.id)
   304	            if object_scope.storage_location_id is not None:
   305	                location = await session.get(StorageLocation, object_scope.storage_location_id)
   306	                if location is None or location.tenant_id != tenant_id:
   307	                    raise InventoryCountError("object_not_found")
   308	                if not address_enabled:
   309	                    raise InventoryCountError("object_not_available_without_address_storage")
   310	                warehouse_id = location.warehouse_id
   311	                stmt = stmt.where(InventoryBalance.storage_location_id == location.id)
   312	        elif object_scope.type in {"pallet", "box", "cargo_place"}:
   313	            container_object = True
   314	            container_kind = cast(ContainerKind, object_scope.type)
   315	            warehouse_id, container_refs = await _container_scope(
   316	                session,
   317	                tenant_id,
   318	                container_kind,
   319	                object_scope.id,
   320	            )
   321	            predicates = [
   322	                and_(
   323	                    InventoryBalance.container_kind == ref_kind,
   324	                    InventoryBalance.container_id == ref_id,
   325	                )
   326	                for ref_kind, ref_id in container_refs
   327	            ]
   328	            stmt = stmt.where(
   329	                StorageLocation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   330	                or_(*predicates),
   331	            )
   332	        else:
   333	            raise InventoryCountError("unsupported_object_type")
   334	
   335	    result = await session.execute(stmt)
   336	    balances = list(result.all())
   337	    if container_object and not balances:
   338	        raise InventoryCountError("container_has_no_stock")
   339	    if warehouse_id is None:
   340	        warehouse_ids = {location.warehouse_id for _, _, location in balances}
   341	        if len(warehouse_ids) == 1:
   342	            warehouse_id = next(iter(warehouse_ids))
   343	        elif not address_enabled and len(warehouse_ids) > 1:
   344	            raise InventoryCountError("warehouse_required_without_address_storage")
   345	
   346	    count = InventoryCount(
   347	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
   348	        status=STATUS_DRAFT,
   349	        source=source,
   350	        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
   351	        seller_id=seller_id,
   352	        category=category,
   353	        created_by_user_id=user_id,
   354	        comment=comment.strip() if comment and comment.strip() else None,
   355	    )
   356	    session.add(count)
   357	    await session.flush()
   358	    session.add_all(
   359	        [
   360	            InventoryCountLine(
   361	                count_id=count.id,
   362	                product_id=balance.product_id,
   363	                storage_location_id=balance.storage_location_id,
   364	                container_kind=balance.container_kind,
   365	                container_id=balance.container_id,
   366	                expected_quantity=int(balance.quantity),
   367	                actual_quantity=None,
   368	                posted_delta=None,
   369	            )
   370	            for balance, _, _ in balances
   371	        ]
   372	    )
   373	    await session.commit()
   374	    loaded = await get_count(session, tenant_id, count.id)
   375	    assert loaded is not None
   376	    return loaded
   377

   379	def _load_options() -> tuple[Any, ...]:
   380	    return (
   381	        selectinload(InventoryCount.warehouse),
   382	        selectinload(InventoryCount.seller),
   383	        selectinload(InventoryCount.created_by),
   384	        selectinload(InventoryCount.posted_by),
   385	        selectinload(InventoryCount.lines).selectinload(InventoryCountLine.product).selectinload(
   386	            Product.seller
   387	        ),
   388	        selectinload(InventoryCount.lines).selectinload(
   389	            InventoryCountLine.storage_location
   390	        ),
   391	    )

   394	async def get_count(
   395	    session: AsyncSession,
   396	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   397	    count_id: uuid.UUID,
   398	) -> InventoryCount | None:
   399	    result = await session.execute(
   400	        select(InventoryCount)
   401	        .where(
   402	            InventoryCount.id == count_id,
   403	            InventoryCount.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   404	        )
   405	        .options(*_load_options())
   406	    )
   407	    return result.scalar_one_or_none()

   410	async def list_counts(
   411	    session: AsyncSession,
   412	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   413	    *,
   414	    status: str | None = None,
   415	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
   416	    seller_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
   417	    created_from: datetime | None = None,
   418	    created_to: datetime | None = None,
   419	) -> list[InventoryCount]:
   420	    stmt = select(InventoryCount).where(InventoryCount.tenant_id == tenant_id)
   421	    if status is not None:
   422	        stmt = stmt.where(InventoryCount.status == status)
   423	    if warehouse_id is not None:
   424	        stmt = stmt.where(InventoryCount.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
   425	    if seller_id is not None:
   426	        stmt = stmt.where(InventoryCount.seller_id == seller_id)
   427	    if created_from is not None:
   428	        stmt = stmt.where(InventoryCount.created_at >= created_from)
   429	    if created_to is not None:
   430	        stmt = stmt.where(InventoryCount.created_at <= created_to)
   431	    result = await session.execute(
   432	        stmt.options(*_load_options()).order_by(InventoryCount.created_at.desc())
   433	    )
   434	    return list(result.scalars().unique().all())

   437	async def save_actuals(
   438	    session: AsyncSession,
   439	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   440	    count_id: uuid.UUID,
   441	    values: list[tuple[uuid.UUID, int | None]],
   442	) -> InventoryCount:
   443	    result = await session.execute(
   444	        select(InventoryCount)
   445	        .where(
   446	            InventoryCount.id == count_id,
   447	            InventoryCount.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   448	        )
   449	        .with_for_update()
   450	    )
   451	    count = result.scalar_one_or_none()
   452	    if count is None:
   453	        raise InventoryCountError("not_found")
   454	    if count.status != STATUS_DRAFT:
   455	        raise InventoryCountError("not_editable")
   456	    line_ids = [line_id for line_id, _ in values]
   457	    if len(line_ids) != len(set(line_ids)):
   458	        raise InventoryCountError("duplicate_line")
   459	    lines_result = await session.execute(
   460	        select(InventoryCountLine)
   461	        .where(
   462	            InventoryCountLine.count_id == count.id,
   463	            InventoryCountLine.id.in_(line_ids),
   464	        )
   465	        .with_for_update()
   466	    )
   467	    lines = {line.id: line for line in lines_result.scalars()}
   468	    if len(lines) != len(line_ids):
   469	        raise InventoryCountError("line_not_found")
   470	    for line_id, actual_quantity in values:
   471	        if actual_quantity is not None and actual_quantity < 0:
   472	            raise InventoryCountError("invalid_actual_quantity")
   473	        lines[line_id].actual_quantity = actual_quantity
   474	    await session.commit()
   475	    loaded = await get_count(session, tenant_id, count.id)
   476	    assert loaded is not None
   477	    return loaded
   478	
   479	
   480	async def _current_quantity(
   481	    session: AsyncSession,
   482	    *,
   483	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   484	    line: InventoryCountLine,
   485	    lock: bool,
   486	) -> int:
   487	    if line.storage_location_id is None:
   488	        raise InventoryCountError("line_storage_location_missing")
   489	    stmt = select(InventoryBalance.quantity).where(
   490	        InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   491	        InventoryBalance.product_id == line.product_id,
   492	        InventoryBalance.storage_location_id == line.storage_location_id,
   493	        InventoryBalance.container_kind == line.container_kind,
   494	        InventoryBalance.container_id == line.container_id,
   495	    )
   496	    if lock:
   497	        stmt = stmt.with_for_update()
   498	    value = await session.scalar(stmt)
   499	    return int(value or 0)
   500	
   501	
   502	async def current_quantities(
   503	    session: AsyncSession,
   504	    count: InventoryCount,
   505	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, int]:
   506	    values: dict[uuid.UUID, int] = {}
   507	    for line in count.lines:
   508	        if count.status == STATUS_POSTED and line.actual_quantity is not None:
   509	            posted_delta = int(line.posted_delta or 0)
   510	            values[line.id] = int(line.actual_quantity) - posted_delta
   511	        else:
   512	            values[line.id] = await _current_quantity(
   513	                session,
   514	                tenant_id=count.tenant_id,
   515	                line=line,
   516	                lock=False,
   517	            )
   518	    return values
   519	
   520	
   521	async def post_count(
   522	    session: AsyncSession,
   523	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   524	    count_id: uuid.UUID,
   525	    user_id: uuid.UUID,
   526	) -> PostResult:
   527	    result = await session.execute(
   528	        select(InventoryCount)
   529	        .where(
   530	            InventoryCount.id == count_id,
   531	            InventoryCount.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   532	        )
   533	        .with_for_update()
   534	    )
   535	    count = result.scalar_one_or_none()
   536	    if count is None:
   537	        raise InventoryCountError("not_found")
   538	    if count.status != STATUS_DRAFT:
   539	        raise InventoryCountError("already_posted")
   540	    lines_result = await session.execute(
   541	        select(InventoryCountLine)
   542	        .where(InventoryCountLine.count_id == count.id)
   543	        .order_by(InventoryCountLine.id)
   544	        .with_for_update()
   545	    )
   546	    entered_lines = [line for line in lines_result.scalars() if line.actual_quantity is not None]
   547	    if not entered_lines:
   548	        raise InventoryCountError("empty_count")
   549	
   550	    changed_balances: list[ChangedBalance] = []
   551	    posted_lines = 0
   552	    for line in entered_lines:
   553	        storage_location_id = line.storage_location_id
   554	        if storage_location_id is None:
   555	            raise InventoryCountError("line_storage_location_missing")
   556	        current = await _current_quantity(
   557	            session,
   558	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
   559	            line=line,
   560	            lock=True,
   561	        )
   562	        if current != line.expected_quantity:
   563	            changed_balances.append(
   564	                ChangedBalance(
   565	                    line_id=line.id,
   566	                    product_id=line.product_id,
   567	                    storage_location_id=storage_location_id,
   568	                    expected_quantity=line.expected_quantity,
   569	                    current_quantity=current,
   570	                )
   571	            )
   572	        assert line.actual_quantity is not None
   573	        delta = int(line.actual_quantity) - current
   574	        line.posted_delta = delta
   575	        if delta == 0:
   576	            continue
   577	        try:
   578	            await inventory_service.record_movement_and_adjust_balance(
   579	                session,
   580	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
   581	                product_id=line.product_id,
   582	                storage_location_id=storage_location_id,
   583	                quantity_delta=delta,
   584	                movement_type=MOVEMENT_TYPE_INVENTORY_COUNT,
   585	                inventory_count_line_id=line.id,
   586	                actor_user_id=user_id,
   587	                container_kind=cast(ContainerKind | None, line.container_kind),
   588	                container_id=line.container_id,
   589	            )
   590	        except ValueError as exc:
   591	            await session.rollback()
   592	            if str(exc) == "insufficient stock":
   593	                raise InventoryCountError("balance_changed_during_post") from exc
   594	            raise
   595	        posted_lines += 1
   596	
   597	    count.status = STATUS_POSTED
   598	    count.posted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
   599	    count.posted_by_user_id = user_id
   600	    await session.commit()
   601	    loaded = await get_count(session, tenant_id, count.id)
   602	    assert loaded is not None
   603	    return PostResult(
   604	        count=loaded,
   605	        posted_lines=posted_lines,
   606	        unchanged_lines=len(entered_lines) - posted_lines,
   607	        changed_balances=changed_balances,
   608	    )
   609	
   610	
   611	async def cancel_count(
   612	    session: AsyncSession,
   613	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   614	    count_id: uuid.UUID,
   615	) -> InventoryCount:
   616	    result = await session.execute(
   617	        select(InventoryCount)
   618	        .where(
   619	            InventoryCount.id == count_id,
   620	            InventoryCount.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   621	        )
   622	        .with_for_update()
   623	    )
   624	    count = result.scalar_one_or_none()
   625	    if count is None:
   626	        raise InventoryCountError("not_found")
   627	    if count.status != STATUS_DRAFT:
   628	        raise InventoryCountError("not_cancellable")
   629	    count.status = STATUS_CANCELLED
   630	    await session.commit()
   631	    loaded = await get_count(session, tenant_id, count.id)
   632	    assert loaded is not None
   633	    return loaded

   636	async def product_categories(
   637	    session: AsyncSession,
   638	    products: list[Product],
   639	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, str | None]:
   640	    result = {product.id: getattr(product, "category", None) for product in products}
   641	    missing = [
   642	        product
   643	        for product in products
   644	        if result[product.id] is None
   645	        and product.seller_id is not None
   646	        and product.wb_nm_id is not None
   647	    ]
   648	    if not missing:
   649	        return result
   650	    pairs = {
   651	        (product.seller_id, product.wb_nm_id)
   652	        for product in missing
   653	        if product.seller_id is not None and product.wb_nm_id is not None
   654	    }
   655	    rows = await session.execute(
   656	        select(SellerWildberriesImportedCard).where(
   657	            SellerWildberriesImportedCard.tenant_id == missing[0].tenant_id,
   658	            or_(
   659	                *[
   660	                    and_(
   661	                        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.seller_id == seller_id,
   662	                        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.nm_id == nm_id,
   663	                    )
   664	                    for seller_id, nm_id in pairs
   665	                ]
   666	            ),
   667	        )
   668	    )
   669	    by_pair = {
   670	        (card.seller_id, card.nm_id): subject_name_from_card(card.raw_json or {})
   671	        for card in rows.scalars()
   672	    }
   673	    for product in missing:
   674	        seller_id = product.seller_id
   675	        nm_id = product.wb_nm_id
   676	        if seller_id is not None and nm_id is not None:
   677	            result[product.id] = by_pair.get((seller_id, nm_id))
   678	    return result

    37	class MarketplaceUnloadBoxError(Exception):
    38	    def __init__(self, code: str) -> None:
    39	        self.code = code
    40	        super().__init__(code)

    43	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    44	class BoxScanResult:
    45	    """TSD scan flow: location (optional) → ready box / product → box line update."""
    46	
    47	    kind: Literal["location", "product", "ready_box"]
    48	    storage_location_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    49	    location_code: str | None = None
    50	    box_line: MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine | None = None
    51	    picked_qty: int | None = None
    52	    lines_added: int | None = None
    53	    total_qty: int | None = None

    56	def _map_collect_err(exc: MarketplaceUnloadPickError) -> MarketplaceUnloadBoxError:
    57	    return MarketplaceUnloadBoxError(exc.code)

    60	async def _barcode_index_for_seller(
    61	    session: AsyncSession,
    62	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
    63	    seller_id: uuid.UUID,
    64	) -> dict[str, uuid.UUID]:
    65	    rows = await list_seller_wb_catalog_rows(session, tenant_id, seller_id)
    66	    idx: dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}
    67	    for r in rows:
    68	        for b in r.wb_barcodes:
    69	            key = str(b).strip()
    70	            if key:
    71	                idx[key] = r.product_id
    72	        if r.wb_primary_barcode:
    73	            k = r.wb_primary_barcode.strip()
    74	            if k:
    75	                idx[k] = r.product_id
    76	    return idx

    79	async def _request_for_picking(
    80	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, request_id: uuid.UUID
    81	) -> MarketplaceUnloadRequest:
    82	    stmt = (
    83	        select(MarketplaceUnloadRequest)
    84	        .where(
    85	            MarketplaceUnloadRequest.id == request_id,
    86	            MarketplaceUnloadRequest.tenant_id == tenant_id,
    87	        )
    88	        .options(selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadRequest.lines))
    89	        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
    90	    )
    91	    req = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
    92	    if req is None:
    93	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("not_found")
    94	    if req.status not in mu_svc.EXECUTION_STATUSES:
    95	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("not_editable")
    96	    if req.seller_id is None:
    97	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("seller_required")
    98	    return req

   107	async def create_open_box(
   108	    session: AsyncSession,
   109	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   110	    request_id: uuid.UUID,
   111	    *,
   112	    box_preset: str,
   113	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBox:
   114	    preset = box_preset.strip()
   115	    if preset not in ALLOWED_BOX_PRESETS:
   116	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_preset")
   117	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, request_id)
   118	    existing = await _open_box_for_request(session, request_id)
   119	    if existing is not None:
   120	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("open_box_exists")
   121	
   122	    wh_box = await wh_box_svc.create_warehouse_box(
   123	        session,
   124	        tenant_id,
   125	        warehouse_id=req.warehouse_id,
   126	    )
   127	    box = MarketplaceUnloadBox(
   128	        request_id=request_id,
   129	        box_preset=preset,
   130	        warehouse_box_id=wh_box.id,
   131	    )
   132	    session.add(box)
   133	    mu_svc.enter_collecting_if_needed(req)
   134	    await session.commit()
   135	    stmt = (
   136	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   137	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id == box.id)
   138	        .options(selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box))
   139	    )
   140	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   141	    return res.scalar_one()

   144	async def create_boxes_batch(
   145	    session: AsyncSession,
   146	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   147	    request_id: uuid.UUID,
   148	    *,
   149	    count: int,
   150	    box_preset: str,
   151	) -> list[MarketplaceUnloadBox]:
   152	    """Create N empty open boxes with barcodes (batch flow; no open_box_exists gate)."""
   153	    if count < 1 or count > MAX_BATCH_BOX_COUNT:
   154	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_batch_count")
   155	    preset = box_preset.strip()
   156	    if preset not in ALLOWED_BOX_PRESETS:
   157	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_preset")
   158	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, request_id)
   159	
   160	    created_ids: list[uuid.UUID] = []
   161	    for _ in range(count):
   162	        wh_box = await wh_box_svc.create_warehouse_box(
   163	            session,
   164	            tenant_id,
   165	            warehouse_id=req.warehouse_id,
   166	        )
   167	        box = MarketplaceUnloadBox(
   168	            request_id=request_id,
   169	            box_preset=preset,
   170	            warehouse_box_id=wh_box.id,
   171	            closed_at=None,
   172	        )
   173	        session.add(box)
   174	        await session.flush()
   175	        created_ids.append(box.id)
   176	
   177	    mu_svc.enter_collecting_if_needed(req)
   178	    await session.commit()
   179	    stmt = (
   180	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   181	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id.in_(created_ids))
   182	        .options(selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box))
   183	        .order_by(MarketplaceUnloadBox.created_at.asc())
   184	    )
   185	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   186	    return list(res.scalars().all())
   187

   189	async def _product_in_shipment(
   190	    session: AsyncSession, request_id: uuid.UUID, product_id: uuid.UUID
   191	) -> bool:
   192	    stmt = select(MarketplaceUnloadLine.id).where(
   193	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.request_id == request_id,
   194	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.product_id == product_id,
   195	    )
   196	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   197	    return res.scalar_one_or_none() is not None

   200	async def collect_ready_box_into_open_box(
   201	    session: AsyncSession,
   202	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   203	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   204	    *,
   205	    barcode: str,
   206	    allow_over_plan: bool = False,
   207	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   208	) -> BoxScanResult:
   209	    """Развернуть состав готового короба (WHB / приёмочный) в открытый короб отгрузки."""
   210	    raw = barcode.strip()
   211	    if not raw:
   212	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("barcode_empty")
   213	
   214	    box = await session.get(MarketplaceUnloadBox, box_id)
   215	    if box is None:
   216	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   217	
   218	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, box.request_id)
   219	    wh_box, inb_box = await wh_box_svc.resolve_barcode(session, tenant_id, raw)
   220	    if wh_box is None and inb_box is None:
   221	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_barcode_unknown")
   222	    if wh_box is not None and wh_box.warehouse_id != req.warehouse_id:
   223	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("warehouse_mismatch")
   224	
   225	    picks_added = 0
   226	    total_qty = 0
   227	    if inb_box is not None:
   228	        distro = await wh_box_svc.distribution_lines_for_inbound_box(session, inb_box.id)
   229	        if distro:
   230	            for dl in distro:
   231	                if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, dl.product_id):
   232	                    continue
   233	                qty = int(dl.quantity)
   234	                try:
   235	                    await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   236	                        session,
   237	                        tenant_id,
   238	                        req.id,
   239	                        box_id=box_id,
   240	                        storage_location_id=dl.storage_location_id,
   241	                        product_id=dl.product_id,
   242	                        quantity=qty,
   243	                        allow_over_plan=allow_over_plan,
   244	                        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   245	                    )
   246	                except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   247	                    raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   248	                picks_added += 1
   249	                total_qty += qty
   250	        else:
   251	            stmt = select(InboundIntakeBoxLine).where(InboundIntakeBoxLine.box_id == inb_box.id)
   252	            res = await session.execute(stmt)
   253	            for bl in res.scalars().all():
   254	                qty = int(bl.posted_qty) if int(bl.posted_qty) > 0 else int(bl.quantity)
   255	                if qty < 1:
   256	                    continue
   257	                if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, bl.product_id):
   258	                    continue
   259	                if wh_box is not None and wh_box.storage_location_id is not None:
   260	                    try:
   261	                        await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   262	                            session,
   263	                            tenant_id,
   264	                            req.id,
   265	                            box_id=box_id,
   266	                            storage_location_id=wh_box.storage_location_id,
   267	                            product_id=bl.product_id,
   268	                            quantity=qty,
   269	                            allow_over_plan=allow_over_plan,
   270	                            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   271	                        )
   272	                    except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   273	                        raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   274	                    picks_added += 1
   275	                    total_qty += qty
   276	
   277	    if inb_box is not None and picks_added < 1:
   278	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_needs_location")
   279	
   280	    mu_svc.enter_collecting_if_needed(req)
   281	    await session.commit()
   282	    return BoxScanResult(
   283	        kind="ready_box",
   284	        lines_added=picks_added,
   285	        total_qty=total_qty,
   286	    )

   289	async def scan_barcode_into_box(
   290	    session: AsyncSession,
   291	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   292	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   293	    *,
   294	    barcode: str,
   295	    request_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
   296	    product_id_hint: uuid.UUID | None = None,
   297	    storage_location_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   298	    quantity: int = 1,
   299	    allow_over_plan: bool = False,
   300	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   301	) -> BoxScanResult:
   302	    """Scan flow for TSD/web: optional location barcode, then product → box line."""
   303	    raw = barcode.strip()
   304	    if not raw:
   305	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("barcode_empty")
   306	    if quantity < 1:
   307	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_quantity")
   308	
   309	    box = await session.get(MarketplaceUnloadBox, box_id)
   310	    if box is None or (request_id is not None and box.request_id != request_id):
   311	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   312	
   313	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, box.request_id)
   314	    if req.seller_id is None:
   315	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("seller_required")
   316	
   317	    address_on = await tenant_settings_svc.is_address_storage_enabled(session, tenant_id)
   318	    if address_on:
   319	        loc = await find_location_by_barcode(session, tenant_id, req.warehouse_id, raw)
   320	        if loc is not None:
   321	            return BoxScanResult(
   322	                kind="location",
   323	                storage_location_id=loc.id,
   324	                location_code=loc.code,
   325	            )
   326	
   327	    wh_box, inb_box = await wh_box_svc.resolve_barcode(session, tenant_id, raw)
   328	    if wh_box is not None or inb_box is not None:
   329	        return await collect_ready_box_into_open_box(
   330	            session,
   331	            tenant_id,
   332	            box_id,
   333	            barcode=raw,
   334	            allow_over_plan=allow_over_plan,
   335	            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   336	        )
   337	
   338	    if product_id_hint is None:
   339	        idx = await _barcode_index_for_seller(session, tenant_id, req.seller_id)
   340	        product_id = idx.get(raw)
   341	        if product_id is None:
   342	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("barcode_unknown")
   343	    else:
   344	        product_id = product_id_hint
   345	
   346	    if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, product_id):
   347	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("product_not_in_shipment")
   348	
   349	    try:
   350	        result = await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   351	            session,
   352	            tenant_id,
   353	            box.request_id,
   354	            box_id=box_id,
   355	            storage_location_id=storage_location_id,
   356	            product_id=product_id,
   357	            quantity=quantity,
   358	            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   359	        )
   360	    except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   361	        raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   362	    return BoxScanResult(
   363	        kind="product",
   364	        storage_location_id=result.allocation.storage_location_id,
   365	        box_line=result.box_line,
   366	        picked_qty=result.picked_qty,
   367	    )
   368	
   369	
   370	async def add_manual_qty_to_box(
   371	    session: AsyncSession,
   372	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   373	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   374	    *,
   375	    product_id: uuid.UUID,
   376	    storage_location_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   377	    quantity: int,
   378	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   379	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine:
   380	    if quantity < 1:
   381	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_quantity")
   382	
   383	    box = await session.get(MarketplaceUnloadBox, box_id)
   384	    if box is None:
   385	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   386	
   387	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, box.request_id)
   388	    if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, product_id):
   389	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("product_not_in_shipment")
   390	
   391	    try:
   392	        result = await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   393	            session,
   394	            tenant_id,
   395	            box.request_id,
   396	            box_id=box_id,
   397	            storage_location_id=storage_location_id,
   398	            product_id=product_id,
   399	            quantity=quantity,
   400	            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   401	        )
   402	    except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   403	        raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   404	    return result.box_line
   405	
   406	
   407	async def attach_existing_box_by_barcode(
   408	    session: AsyncSession,
   409	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   410	    request_id: uuid.UUID,
   411	    *,
   412	    barcode: str,
   413	    box_preset: str = "60_40_40",
   414	    allow_over_plan: bool = False,
   415	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   416	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBox:
   417	    """Привязать существующий короб (WHB или приёмочный) и развернуть состав в подбор."""
   418	    preset = box_preset.strip()
   419	    if preset not in ALLOWED_BOX_PRESETS:
   420	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("invalid_preset")
   421	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, request_id)
   422	
   423	    wh_box, inb_box = await wh_box_svc.resolve_barcode(session, tenant_id, barcode)
   424	    if wh_box is None and inb_box is None:
   425	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_barcode_unknown")
   426	
   427	    if wh_box is not None and wh_box.warehouse_id != req.warehouse_id:
   428	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("warehouse_mismatch")
   429	
   430	    mp_box = MarketplaceUnloadBox(
   431	        request_id=request_id,
   432	        box_preset=preset,
   433	        warehouse_box_id=wh_box.id if wh_box is not None else None,
   434	    )
   435	    session.add(mp_box)
   436	    await session.flush()
   437	
   438	    picks_added = 0
   439	    if inb_box is not None:
   440	        distro = await wh_box_svc.distribution_lines_for_inbound_box(session, inb_box.id)
   441	        if distro:
   442	            for dl in distro:
   443	                if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, dl.product_id):
   444	                    continue
   445	                try:
   446	                    await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   447	                        session,
   448	                        tenant_id,
   449	                        request_id,
   450	                        box_id=mp_box.id,
   451	                        storage_location_id=dl.storage_location_id,
   452	                        product_id=dl.product_id,
   453	                        quantity=int(dl.quantity),
   454	                        require_open_box=False,
   455	                        allow_over_plan=allow_over_plan,
   456	                        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   457	                    )
   458	                except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   459	                    raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   460	                picks_added += 1
   461	        else:
   462	            stmt = select(InboundIntakeBoxLine).where(InboundIntakeBoxLine.box_id == inb_box.id)
   463	            res = await session.execute(stmt)
   464	            for bl in res.scalars().all():
   465	                qty = int(bl.posted_qty) if int(bl.posted_qty) > 0 else int(bl.quantity)
   466	                if qty < 1:
   467	                    continue
   468	                if not await _product_in_shipment(session, req.id, bl.product_id):
   469	                    continue
   470	                if wh_box is not None and wh_box.storage_location_id is not None:
   471	                    try:
   472	                        await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   473	                            session,
   474	                            tenant_id,
   475	                            request_id,
   476	                            box_id=mp_box.id,
   477	                            storage_location_id=wh_box.storage_location_id,
   478	                            product_id=bl.product_id,
   479	                            quantity=qty,
   480	                            require_open_box=False,
   481	                            allow_over_plan=allow_over_plan,
   482	                            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   483	                        )
   484	                    except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   485	                        raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   486	                    picks_added += 1
   487	
   488	    if inb_box is not None and picks_added < 1:
   489	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_needs_location")
   490	
   491	    if wh_box is not None and inb_box is None:
   492	        dup_stmt = select(MarketplaceUnloadBox).where(
   493	            MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box_id == wh_box.id,
   494	            MarketplaceUnloadBox.request_id == request_id,
   495	            MarketplaceUnloadBox.id != mp_box.id,
   496	        )
   497	        res = await session.execute(dup_stmt)
   498	        if res.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
   499	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_already_attached")
   500	
   501	    mp_box.closed_at = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
   502	    mu_svc.enter_collecting_if_needed(req)
   503	    await session.commit()
   504	    await session.refresh(mp_box, attribute_names=["warehouse_box", "lines"])
   505	    return mp_box
   506

   525	async def list_boxes_with_lines(
   526	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, request_id: uuid.UUID
   527	) -> list[MarketplaceUnloadBox]:
   528	    req = await mu_svc.get_request(session, tenant_id, request_id)
   529	    if req is None:
   530	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("not_found")
   531	    stmt = (
   532	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   533	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.request_id == request_id)
   534	        .options(
   535	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines).selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.product),
   536	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   537	        )
   538	        .order_by(MarketplaceUnloadBox.created_at.asc())
   539	    )
   540	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   541	    return list(res.scalars().unique().all())

   550	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,

   579	async def delete_box(
   580	    session: AsyncSession,
   581	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   582	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   583	) -> None:
   584	    box = await session.get(MarketplaceUnloadBox, box_id)
   585	    if box is None:
   586	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   587	    await session.refresh(box, attribute_names=["lines"])
   588	    await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, box.request_id)
   589	    total_stmt = select(
   590	        func.coalesce(func.sum(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.quantity), 0)
   591	    ).where(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.box_id == box_id)
   592	    total_qty = int((await session.execute(total_stmt)).scalar_one())
   593	    if total_qty > 0:
   594	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_empty")
   595	    await session.delete(box)
   596	    await session.commit()

   599	async def copy_box(
   600	    session: AsyncSession,
   601	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   602	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   603	    *,
   604	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   605	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBox:
   606	    """Duplicate a closed source box into a new closed box (REV-FIX-015).
   607	
   608	    Intentionally closed: copy is a snapshot for shipping labels / repeat shipment,
   609	    not for further manual add (use batch create for open boxes).
   610	    """
   611	    src_stmt = (
   612	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   613	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id == box_id)
   614	        .options(
   615	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines),
   616	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   617	        )
   618	        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
   619	    )
   620	    src = (await session.execute(src_stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
   621	    if src is None:
   622	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   623	    await session.refresh(src, attribute_names=["lines"])
   624	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, src.request_id)
   625	    if not src.lines:
   626	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_empty")
   627	
   628	    picked = await collect_svc.picked_qty_by_product(session, req.id)
   629	    plan_stmt = select(
   630	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.product_id,
   631	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.quantity,
   632	    ).where(MarketplaceUnloadLine.request_id == req.id)
   633	    plan_by_product = {
   634	        product_id: int(quantity)
   635	        for product_id, quantity in (await session.execute(plan_stmt)).all()
   636	    }
   637	    for ln in src.lines:
   638	        pid = ln.product_id
   639	        add_qty = int(ln.quantity)
   640	        if add_qty < 1:
   641	            continue
   642	        current = picked.get(pid, 0)
   643	        plan_qty = plan_by_product.get(pid, 0)
   644	        if current + add_qty > plan_qty:
   645	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("plan_limit_exceeded")
   646	
   647	    wh_box = await wh_box_svc.create_warehouse_box(
   648	        session,
   649	        tenant_id,
   650	        warehouse_id=req.warehouse_id,
   651	    )
   652	    new_box = MarketplaceUnloadBox(
   653	        request_id=req.id,
   654	        box_preset=src.box_preset,
   655	        warehouse_box_id=wh_box.id,
   656	    )
   657	    session.add(new_box)
   658	    await session.flush()
   659	
   660	    for ln in src.lines:
   661	        qty = int(ln.quantity)
   662	        if qty < 1:
   663	            continue
   664	        remaining = qty
   665	        alloc_stmt = (
   666	            select(MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation)
   667	            .where(
   668	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.request_id == req.id,
   669	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.product_id == ln.product_id,
   670	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.quantity > 0,
   671	            )
   672	            .order_by(MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.quantity.desc())
   673	        )
   674	        alloc_res = await session.execute(alloc_stmt)
   675	        allocs = list(alloc_res.scalars().all())
   676	        if not allocs:
   677	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("insufficient_available")
   678	        for alloc in allocs:
   679	            if remaining < 1:
   680	                break
   681	            chunk = min(int(alloc.quantity), remaining)
   682	            try:
   683	                await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   684	                    session,
   685	                    tenant_id,
   686	                    req.id,
   687	                    box_id=new_box.id,
   688	                    storage_location_id=alloc.storage_location_id,
   689	                    product_id=ln.product_id,
   690	                    quantity=chunk,
   691	                    require_open_box=False,
   692	                    actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   693	                )
   694	            except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   695	                raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   696	            remaining -= chunk
   697	        if remaining > 0:
   698	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("insufficient_available")
   699	
   700	    new_box.closed_at = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
   701	    await session.commit()
   702	
   703	    stmt = (
   704	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   705	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id == new_box.id)
   706	        .options(
   707	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines).selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.product),
   708	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   709	        )
   710	    )
   711	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   712	    return res.scalars().unique().one()

   178	class MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine(Base):
   179	    __tablename__ = "marketplace_unload_box_lines"
   180	    __table_args__ = (
   181	        UniqueConstraint(
   182	            "box_id",
   183	            "product_id",
   184	            name="uq_marketplace_unload_box_line_box_product",
   185	        ),
   186	    )
   187	
   188	    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(Uuid(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
   189	    box_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(

   315	async def combine_into_pallet(
   316	    session: AsyncSession,
   317	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   318	    pallet_id: uuid.UUID,
   319	    *,
   320	    inbound_box_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   321	    cargo_place_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   322	    warehouse_box_ids: Iterable[uuid.UUID] = (),
   323	) -> Pallet:
   324	    pallet = await _load_pallet(session, tenant_id, pallet_id, for_update=True)
   325	    if pallet.disbanded_at is not None:
   326	        raise PalletServiceError("pallet_disbanded")
   327	    inbound_ids = set(inbound_box_ids)
   328	    cargo_ids = set(cargo_place_ids)
   329	    warehouse_ids = set(warehouse_box_ids)
   330	    if not inbound_ids and not cargo_ids and not warehouse_ids:
   331	        raise PalletServiceError("containers_required")
   332	
   333	    inbound_boxes = await _load_inbound_boxes(
   334	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, inbound_ids
   335	    )
   336	    cargo_places = await _load_cargo_places(
   337	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, cargo_ids
   338	    )
   339	    warehouse_boxes = await _load_warehouse_boxes(
   340	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id, warehouse_ids
   341	    )
   342	    destination = pallet.storage_location_id
   343	    if destination is None:
   344	        sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(
   345	            session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id
   346	        )
   347	        destination = sorting.id
   348	
   349	    for box in inbound_boxes:
   350	        box.pallet_id = pallet.id
   351	    for place in cargo_places:
   352	        place.pallet_id = pallet.id
   353	    for warehouse_box in warehouse_boxes:
   354	        warehouse_box.pallet_id = pallet.id
   355	        warehouse_box.storage_location_id = pallet.storage_location_id
   356	    await _move_container_balances(
   357	        session,
   358	        tenant_id,
   359	        pallet.warehouse_id,
   360	        refs=[
   361	            *(("box", box.id) for box in inbound_boxes),
   362	            *((box.container_kind, box.id) for box in warehouse_boxes),
   363	            *(("cargo_place", place.id) for place in cargo_places),
   364	        ],
   365	        destination_location_id=destination,
   366	    )
   367	    await session.commit()
   368	    await session.refresh(pallet)
   369	    return pallet

   372	async def disband_pallet(
   373	    session: AsyncSession,
   374	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   375	    pallet_id: uuid.UUID,
   376	) -> Pallet:
   377	    pallet = await _load_pallet(session, tenant_id, pallet_id, for_update=True)
   378	    if pallet.disbanded_at is not None:
   379	        raise PalletServiceError("pallet_disbanded")
   380	    sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(
   381	        session, tenant_id, pallet.warehouse_id
   382	    )
   383	    inbound_boxes = list(
   384	        (
   385	            await session.execute(
   386	                select(InboundIntakeBox).where(
   387	                    InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   388	                    InboundIntakeBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   389	                )
   390	            )
   391	        )
   392	        .scalars()
   393	        .all()
   394	    )
   395	    cargo_places = list(
   396	        (
   397	            await session.execute(
   398	                select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace).where(
   399	                    InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   400	                    InboundIntakeCargoPlace.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   401	                )
   402	            )
   403	        )
   404	        .scalars()
   405	        .all()
   406	    )
   407	    warehouse_boxes = list(
   408	        (
   409	            await session.execute(
   410	                select(WarehouseBox).where(
   411	                    WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   412	                    WarehouseBox.pallet_id == pallet.id,
   413	                )
   414	            )
   415	        )
   416	        .scalars()
   417	        .all()
   418	    )
   419	    await _move_container_balances(
   420	        session,
   421	        tenant_id,
   422	        pallet.warehouse_id,
   423	        refs=[
   424	            *(("box", box.id) for box in inbound_boxes),
   425	            *((box.container_kind, box.id) for box in warehouse_boxes),
   426	            *(("cargo_place", place.id) for place in cargo_places),
   427	        ],
   428	        destination_location_id=sorting.id,
   429	    )
   430	    await _detach_direct_pallet_balances(
   431	        session, tenant_id, pallet.id, sorting.id
   432	    )
   433	    for box in inbound_boxes:
   434	        box.pallet_id = None
   435	    for place in cargo_places:
   436	        place.pallet_id = None
   437	    for warehouse_box in warehouse_boxes:
   438	        warehouse_box.pallet_id = None
   439	        warehouse_box.storage_location_id = None
   440	    pallet.storage_location_id = None
   441	    pallet.disbanded_at = datetime.now(UTC)
   442	    await session.commit()
   443	    await session.refresh(pallet)
   444	    return pallet

   525	async def list_boxes_with_lines(
   526	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, request_id: uuid.UUID
   527	) -> list[MarketplaceUnloadBox]:
   528	    req = await mu_svc.get_request(session, tenant_id, request_id)
   529	    if req is None:
   530	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("not_found")
   531	    stmt = (
   532	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   533	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.request_id == request_id)
   534	        .options(
   535	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines).selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.product),
   536	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   537	        )
   538	        .order_by(MarketplaceUnloadBox.created_at.asc())
   539	    )
   540	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   541	    return list(res.scalars().unique().all())

   545	    return sum(int(ln.quantity) for ln in box.lines)

   548	async def remove_box_line(
   549	    session: AsyncSession,
   550	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   551	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   552	    line_id: uuid.UUID,
   553	    *,
   554	    quantity: int | None = None,
   555	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   556	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine | None:

   573	            actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   574	        )
   575	    except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   576	        raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None

   579	async def delete_box(
   580	    session: AsyncSession,
   581	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   582	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   583	) -> None:
   584	    box = await session.get(MarketplaceUnloadBox, box_id)
   585	    if box is None:
   586	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   587	    await session.refresh(box, attribute_names=["lines"])
   588	    await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, box.request_id)
   589	    total_stmt = select(
   590	        func.coalesce(func.sum(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.quantity), 0)
   591	    ).where(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.box_id == box_id)
   592	    total_qty = int((await session.execute(total_stmt)).scalar_one())
   593	    if total_qty > 0:
   594	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_empty")
   595	    await session.delete(box)
   596	    await session.commit()

   599	async def copy_box(
   600	    session: AsyncSession,
   601	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   602	    box_id: uuid.UUID,
   603	    *,
   604	    actor_user_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   605	) -> MarketplaceUnloadBox:
   606	    """Duplicate a closed source box into a new closed box (REV-FIX-015).
   607	
   608	    Intentionally closed: copy is a snapshot for shipping labels / repeat shipment,
   609	    not for further manual add (use batch create for open boxes).
   610	    """
   611	    src_stmt = (
   612	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   613	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id == box_id)
   614	        .options(
   615	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines),
   616	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   617	        )
   618	        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
   619	    )
   620	    src = (await session.execute(src_stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
   621	    if src is None:
   622	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_not_found")
   623	    await session.refresh(src, attribute_names=["lines"])
   624	    req = await _request_for_picking(session, tenant_id, src.request_id)
   625	    if not src.lines:
   626	        raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("box_empty")
   627	
   628	    picked = await collect_svc.picked_qty_by_product(session, req.id)
   629	    plan_stmt = select(
   630	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.product_id,
   631	        MarketplaceUnloadLine.quantity,
   632	    ).where(MarketplaceUnloadLine.request_id == req.id)
   633	    plan_by_product = {
   634	        product_id: int(quantity)
   635	        for product_id, quantity in (await session.execute(plan_stmt)).all()
   636	    }
   637	    for ln in src.lines:
   638	        pid = ln.product_id
   639	        add_qty = int(ln.quantity)
   640	        if add_qty < 1:
   641	            continue
   642	        current = picked.get(pid, 0)
   643	        plan_qty = plan_by_product.get(pid, 0)
   644	        if current + add_qty > plan_qty:
   645	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("plan_limit_exceeded")
   646	
   647	    wh_box = await wh_box_svc.create_warehouse_box(
   648	        session,
   649	        tenant_id,
   650	        warehouse_id=req.warehouse_id,
   651	    )
   652	    new_box = MarketplaceUnloadBox(
   653	        request_id=req.id,
   654	        box_preset=src.box_preset,
   655	        warehouse_box_id=wh_box.id,
   656	    )
   657	    session.add(new_box)
   658	    await session.flush()
   659	
   660	    for ln in src.lines:
   661	        qty = int(ln.quantity)
   662	        if qty < 1:
   663	            continue
   664	        remaining = qty
   665	        alloc_stmt = (
   666	            select(MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation)
   667	            .where(
   668	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.request_id == req.id,
   669	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.product_id == ln.product_id,
   670	                MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.quantity > 0,
   671	            )
   672	            .order_by(MarketplaceUnloadPickAllocation.quantity.desc())
   673	        )
   674	        alloc_res = await session.execute(alloc_stmt)
   675	        allocs = list(alloc_res.scalars().all())
   676	        if not allocs:
   677	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("insufficient_available")
   678	        for alloc in allocs:
   679	            if remaining < 1:
   680	                break
   681	            chunk = min(int(alloc.quantity), remaining)
   682	            try:
   683	                await collect_svc.collect_into_box(
   684	                    session,
   685	                    tenant_id,
   686	                    req.id,
   687	                    box_id=new_box.id,
   688	                    storage_location_id=alloc.storage_location_id,
   689	                    product_id=ln.product_id,
   690	                    quantity=chunk,
   691	                    require_open_box=False,
   692	                    actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
   693	                )
   694	            except MarketplaceUnloadPickError as exc:
   695	                raise _map_collect_err(exc) from None
   696	            remaining -= chunk
   697	        if remaining > 0:
   698	            raise MarketplaceUnloadBoxError("insufficient_available")
   699	
   700	    new_box.closed_at = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
   701	    await session.commit()
   702	
   703	    stmt = (
   704	        select(MarketplaceUnloadBox)
   705	        .where(MarketplaceUnloadBox.id == new_box.id)
   706	        .options(
   707	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.lines).selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBoxLine.product),
   708	            selectinload(MarketplaceUnloadBox.warehouse_box),
   709	        )
   710	    )
   711	    res = await session.execute(stmt)
   712	    return res.scalars().unique().one()
   790	        stmt = stmt.with_for_update()
   791	    result = await session.execute(stmt)
   792	    return result.scalar_one_or_none()

   795	async def bind_packaging_box_to_trbx(
   796	    session: AsyncSession,
   797	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   798	    supply_id: uuid.UUID,
   799	    trbx_id: uuid.UUID,
   800	    packaging_box_id: uuid.UUID,
   801	) -> FbsTrbx:
   802	    # Binding a box to a WB cargo place (trbx) is not PVZ-specific: WB accepts
   803	    # cargo places for any delivery_type (see fbs_shipment_pvz_service module
   804	    # docstring), so a warehouse_sc supply may have trbxes to bind too.
   805	    supply = await _load_supply(
   806	        session,
   807	        tenant_id,
   808	        supply_id,
   809	        with_trbxes=True,
   810	        for_update=True,
   811	    )
   812	    if supply is None:
   813	        raise FbsPackagingIntegrationError("supply_not_found")
   814	
   815	    trbx = next((row for row in supply.trbxes if row.id == trbx_id), None)
   816	    if trbx is None:
   817	        raise FbsPackagingIntegrationError("trbx_not_found")
   818	
   819	    box = await session.scalar(
   820	        select(WarehouseBox)
   821	        .where(
   822	            WarehouseBox.id == packaging_box_id,
   823	            WarehouseBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   824	            WarehouseBox.warehouse_id == supply.warehouse_id,
   825	        )
   826	        .with_for_update()
   827	    )
   828	    if box is None:
   829	        raise FbsPackagingIntegrationError("packaging_box_not_found")
   830	
   831	    already_bound = await session.scalar(
   832	        select(FbsTrbx.id).where(
   833	            FbsTrbx.packaging_box_id == packaging_box_id,
   834	            FbsTrbx.id != trbx.id,
   835	        )
   836	    )
   837	    if already_bound is not None:
   838	        raise FbsPackagingIntegrationError("packaging_box_already_bound")
   839	    try:
   840	        async with session.begin_nested():
   841	            trbx.packaging_box_id = packaging_box_id
   842	            await session.flush()
   843	    except IntegrityError as exc:
   844	        raise FbsPackagingIntegrationError("packaging_box_already_bound") from exc
   845	    return trbx
  2100	    supply_id: uuid.UUID,
  2101	    body: FbsSupplyStatusBody,
  2102	    user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_fbs_operator_access)],
  2103	    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
  2104	) -> FbsSupplyOut:
  2105	    try:
  2106	        await pack_int_svc.update_supply_status(
  2107	            session,
  2108	            user.tenant_id,
  2109	            supply_id,
  2110	            body.status,
  2111	        )
  2112	    except pack_int_svc.FbsPackagingIntegrationError as exc:
  2113	        _raise_from_packaging_integration(exc)
  2114	    await session.commit()
  2115	    refreshed = await supply_svc.get_supply(session, user.tenant_id, supply_id)
  2116	    return _supply_out(refreshed, include_orders=True)

   535	async def _container_location_id(
   536	    session: AsyncSession,
   537	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   538	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   539	    kind: ContainerKind,
   540	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   541	) -> uuid.UUID:
   542	    await validate_container(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, kind, container_id)
   543	    if kind == "pallet":
   544	        pallet = await session.get(Pallet, container_id)
   545	        assert pallet is not None
   546	        if pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   547	            return pallet.storage_location_id
   548	    if kind == "box":
   549	        box = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   550	        if (
   551	            box is not None
   552	            and box.tenant_id == tenant_id
   553	            and box.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   554	            and box.container_kind == kind
   555	        ):
   556	            if box.pallet_id is not None:
   557	                pallet = await session.get(Pallet, box.pallet_id)
   558	                if pallet is not None and pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   559	                    return pallet.storage_location_id
   560	            if box.storage_location_id is not None:
   561	                return box.storage_location_id
   562	    if kind == "cargo_place":
   563	        cargo_place = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   564	        if (
   565	            cargo_place is not None
   566	            and cargo_place.tenant_id == tenant_id
   567	            and cargo_place.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   568	            and cargo_place.container_kind == kind
   569	        ):
   570	            if cargo_place.pallet_id is not None:
   571	                pallet = await session.get(Pallet, cargo_place.pallet_id)
   572	                if pallet is not None and pallet.storage_location_id is not None:
   573	                    return pallet.storage_location_id
   574	            if cargo_place.storage_location_id is not None:
   575	                return cargo_place.storage_location_id
   576	    balance_location = await session.scalar(
   577	        select(InventoryBalance.storage_location_id)
   578	        .where(
   579	            InventoryBalance.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   580	            InventoryBalance.container_kind == kind,
   581	            InventoryBalance.container_id == container_id,
   582	            InventoryBalance.quantity > 0,
   583	        )
   584	        .limit(1)
   585	    )
   586	    if balance_location is not None:
   587	        location = await session.get(StorageLocation, balance_location)
   588	        if location is not None and location.warehouse_id == warehouse_id:
   589	            return balance_location
   590	    sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   591	    return sorting.id
   592	
   593	
   594	async def _destination(
   595	    session: AsyncSession,
   596	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   597	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   598	    to_kind: DestinationKind,
   599	    to_id: uuid.UUID | None,
   600	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID, ContainerKind | None, uuid.UUID | None, str]:
   601	    if to_kind == "cell":
   602	        if not await is_address_storage_enabled(session, tenant_id):
   603	            raise WarehouseMapError("address_storage_disabled")
   604	        if to_id is None:
   605	            raise WarehouseMapError("destination_required")
   606	        location = await session.get(StorageLocation, to_id)
   607	        if (
   608	            location is None
   609	            or location.tenant_id != tenant_id
   610	            or location.warehouse_id != warehouse_id
   611	            or location.deleted_at is not None
   612	            or location.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE
   613	        ):
   614	            raise WarehouseMapError("cell_not_found")
   615	        return location.id, None, None, f"Ячейка {location.code}"
   616	    if to_kind in {"unassigned", "sorting"}:
   617	        sorting = await get_or_create_sorting_location(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id)
   618	        return sorting.id, None, None, UNASSIGNED_LABEL
   619	    if to_id is None:
   620	        raise WarehouseMapError("destination_required")
   621	    container_kind = cast(ContainerKind, to_kind)
   622	    try:
   623	        location_id = await _container_location_id(
   624	            session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, to_id
   625	        )
   626	    except ValueError as exc:
   627	        raise WarehouseMapError("destination_not_found") from exc
   628	    code = await _container_code(session, tenant_id, warehouse_id, container_kind, to_id)
   629	    return location_id, container_kind, to_id, _container_title(container_kind, code)

   631	
   632	async def _container_code(
   633	    session: AsyncSession,
   634	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
   635	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   636	    kind: ContainerKind,
   637	    container_id: uuid.UUID,
   638	) -> str:
   639	    if kind == "pallet":
   640	        row = await session.get(Pallet, container_id)
   641	        if row is not None and row.tenant_id == tenant_id and row.warehouse_id == warehouse_id:
   642	            return row.code
   643	    elif kind == "box":
   644	        warehouse_box = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   645	        if (
   646	            warehouse_box is not None
   647	            and warehouse_box.tenant_id == tenant_id
   648	            and warehouse_box.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   649	            and warehouse_box.container_kind == "box"
   650	        ):
   651	            return warehouse_box.internal_barcode
   652	        inbound = await session.scalar(
   653	            select(InboundIntakeBox)
   654	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   655	            .where(
   656	                InboundIntakeBox.id == container_id,
   657	                InboundIntakeBox.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   658	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   659	            )
   660	        )
   661	        if inbound is not None:
   662	            return f"КР-{inbound.box_number:06d}"
   663	    else:
   664	        warehouse_cargo_place = await session.get(WarehouseBox, container_id)
   665	        if (
   666	            warehouse_cargo_place is not None
   667	            and warehouse_cargo_place.tenant_id == tenant_id
   668	            and warehouse_cargo_place.warehouse_id == warehouse_id
   669	            and warehouse_cargo_place.container_kind == "cargo_place"
   670	        ):
   671	            return warehouse_cargo_place.internal_barcode
   672	        cargo = await session.scalar(
   673	            select(InboundIntakeCargoPlace)
   674	            .join(InboundIntakeRequest)
   675	            .where(
   676	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.id == container_id,
   677	                InboundIntakeCargoPlace.tenant_id == tenant_id,
   678	                InboundIntakeRequest.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
   679	            )
   680	        )
   681	        if cargo is not None:
   682	            return f"ГМ-{cargo.place_number:06d}"
   683	    raise WarehouseMapError("object_not_found")
   684

   686	async def _location_label(session: AsyncSession, location_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
   687	    location = await session.get(StorageLocation, location_id)
   688	    if location is None or location.code == SORTING_LOCATION_CODE:
   689	        return UNASSIGNED_LABEL
   690	    return f"Ячейка {location.code}"

   242	def _map_error(exc: WarehouseMapError) -> HTTPException:
   243	    if exc.code in {
   244	        "warehouse_not_found",
   245	        "object_not_found",
   246	        "destination_not_found",
   247	        "cell_not_found",
   248	        "pallet_not_found",
   249	    }:
   250	        return HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=exc.code)
   251	    if exc.code in {
   252	        "address_storage_disabled",
   253	        "container_cycle",
   254	        "invalid_container_destination",
   255	        "insufficient_stock",
   256	        "pallet_disbanded",
   257	        "pallet_identifier_conflict",
   258	    }:
   259	        return HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=exc.code)
   260	    return HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail=exc.code)
   650	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
   651	    location_id: uuid.UUID,
   652	    body: LocationPatch,
   653	    user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_cells_access)],
   654	    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
   655	) -> LocationOut:
   656	    await _require_address_storage(session, user.tenant_id)
   657	    try:
   658	        loc = await rename_location(
   659	            session,
   660	            user.tenant_id,
   661	            warehouse_id,
   662	            location_id,
   663	            code=body.code,
   664	        )
   665	    except CatalogError as exc:
   666	        if exc.code == "location_not_found":
   667	            raise HTTPException(
   668	                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
   669	                detail="location_not_found",
   670	            ) from None
   671	        if exc.code == "system_location_locked":
   672	            raise HTTPException(
   673	                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
   674	                detail="system_location_locked",
   675	            ) from None
   676	        if exc.code == "invalid_location_code":
   677	            raise HTTPException(
   678	                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
   679	                detail="invalid_location_code",
   680	            ) from None
   681	        if exc.code == "location_code_taken":
   682	            raise HTTPException(
   683	                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
   684	                detail="location_code_taken",
   685	            ) from None
   686	        raise
   687	    return LocationOut(
   688	        id=str(loc.id),
   689	        code=loc.code,
   690	        warehouse_id=str(loc.warehouse_id),
   691	        barcode=loc.barcode,
   692	    )

   123	def test_amount_from_percent_rounds_down() -> None:
   124	    # Дано: свободно 324 штуки и доля 50%. Ожидаемо: 162 штуки.
   125	    assert amount_from_percent(324, 50) == 162
   126	    # Округление вниз: недодать безопаснее, чем продать то, чего нет.
   127	    assert amount_from_percent(7, 30) == 2
   128	    # Негатив: нечего отдавать — ноль, а не отрицательное число.
   129	    assert amount_from_percent(0, 100) == 0
   130	    assert amount_from_percent(-5, 50) == 0

   133	def test_validate_rule_rejects_sum_over_hundred() -> None:
   134	    # Дано: свои доли по двум складам, 100% и 70%.
   135	    rule = FbsRule(
   136	        publish=True,
   137	        same_everywhere=False,
   138	        percent=0,
   139	        by_warehouse={1: 100, 2: 70},
   140	    )
   141	    # Когда правило проверяют. Тогда: отказ — столько товара просто нет.
   142	    with pytest.raises(FbsStockRuleError) as exc:
   143	        validate_rule(rule, served_warehouse_count=2)
   144	    assert exc.value.code == "percent_sum_exceeded"
   145	
   146	    # Ограничение действует и на «одинаково везде»: 60% на два склада это 120%.
   147	    same = FbsRule(publish=True, same_everywhere=True, percent=60, by_warehouse={})
   148	    with pytest.raises(FbsStockRuleError):

   313	            InventoryBalance(
   314	                id=uuid.uuid4(),
   315	                tenant_id=seed.tenant.id,
   316	                storage_location_id=location.id,
   317	                product_id=second_product.id,
   318	                quantity=80,
   319	            ),
   320	        ]
   321	    )

   324	    await set_rule_for_products(
   325	        db_session,
   326	        seed.tenant.id,
   327	        product_ids,
   328	        FbsRule(publish=True, same_everywhere=True, percent=50, by_warehouse={}),
   329	    )
   330	
   331	    bulk = await get_rule_views(db_session, seed.tenant.id, product_ids)
   332	    singles = {
   333	        product_id: await get_rule_view(db_session, seed.tenant.id, product_id)
   334	        for product_id in product_ids
   335	    }
   336	
   337	    assert bulk == singles
   338	    assert bulk[second_product.id].published_now == 40
   339	    assert bulk[seed.product.id].published_now == 210

   125	def _raise_from_binding_service(exc: binding_svc.FbsWarehouseBindingError) -> None:
   126	    detail = envelope_from_exc(exc)
   127	    if exc.code in {
   128	        "seller_not_found",
   129	        "warehouse_not_found",
   130	        "binding_not_found",
   131	        "product_not_found",
   132	    }:
   133	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=detail)
   134	    if exc.code in {"invalid_wb_warehouse_id", "invalid_quantity"}:
   135	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=detail)
   136	    if exc.code == "wms_warehouse_required":
   137	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT, detail=detail)
   138	    if exc.code in {
   139	        "wms_warehouse_already_bound",
   140	        "wb_warehouse_already_bound",
   141	        "active_fbs_reservations",
   142	        "pool_quota_exceeded",
   143	    }:
   144	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=detail)
   145	    raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, detail=detail)

   293	@router.put(
   294	    "/{seller_id}/warehouse-bindings/{wb_warehouse_id}",
   295	    response_model=FbsWarehouseBindingOut,
   296	)
   297	async def upsert_fbs_warehouse_binding(
   298	    seller_id: uuid.UUID,
   299	    wb_warehouse_id: Annotated[int, Path(gt=0)],
   300	    body: FbsWarehouseBindingUpsert,
   301	    user: Annotated[User, Depends(require_fulfillment_admin)],
   302	    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db)],
   303	) -> FbsWarehouseBindingOut:
   304	    was_enabled = False
   305	    try:
   306	        existing = await binding_svc.get_binding(
   307	            session, user.tenant_id, seller_id, wb_warehouse_id
   308	        )
   309	        was_enabled = bool(existing.is_active and existing.stock_sync_enabled)
   310	    except binding_svc.FbsWarehouseBindingError:
   311	        was_enabled = False
   312	
   313	    try:
   314	        row = await binding_svc.upsert_binding(
   315	            session,
   316	            user.tenant_id,
   317	            seller_id,
   318	            wb_warehouse_id,
   319	            wms_warehouse_id=body.wms_warehouse_id,
   320	            stock_sync_enabled=body.stock_sync_enabled,
   321	        )
   322	    except binding_svc.FbsWarehouseBindingError as exc:
   323	        _raise_from_binding_service(exc)
   324	
   325	    if was_enabled and not body.stock_sync_enabled:
   326	        # Оператор снял тумблер — WB не должен вечно хранить старое положительное
   327	        # число. Помечаем "ожидание" сразу (синхронно), пока WB не подтвердил ноль,
   328	        # а саму публикацию нуля выполняем асинхронно в фоне.
   329	        row.last_sync_status = STOCK_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING
   330	        row.last_error_code = None
   331	        await session.commit()
   332	        await session.refresh(row)
   333	        schedule_explicit_zero_publish(user.tenant_id, seller_id, row.id)
   334	
   335	    return _binding_out(row)

   357	async def _stock_pool_images_by_nm_id(
   358	    session: AsyncSession,
   359	    seller_id: uuid.UUID,
   360	    products: list[Product],
   361	) -> dict[int, str]:
   362	    """Фото товаров одним запросом: карточек на складе тысячи, поштучно нельзя."""
   363	    nm_ids = {int(p.wb_nm_id) for p in products if p.wb_nm_id is not None}
   364	    if not nm_ids:
   365	        return {}
   366	    stmt = select(
   367	        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.nm_id,
   368	        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.raw_json,
   369	    ).where(
   370	        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.seller_id == seller_id,
   371	        SellerWildberriesImportedCard.nm_id.in_(sorted(nm_ids)),
   372	    )
   373	    images: dict[int, str] = {}
   374	    for nm_id, raw in (await session.execute(stmt)).all():
   375	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   376	            continue
   377	        url = first_photo_url_from_card(raw)
   378	        if url:
   379	            images[int(nm_id)] = url
   380	    return images
